text: **Albanian** is not very closely related to any other European languages, and therefore has a fairly distinct look.
Words often contain the letter Ë, ë, and sometimes Ç ç.
text_zh: **阿爾巴尼亞語**與其他歐洲語言的關聯性不高，因此外觀相當獨特。
單字中常包含字母 Ë、ë，有時也會有 Ç、ç。

text: The Albanian word for street is **rruga**.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞語的街道是 **rruga**。

text: **Mercedes** is the most popular car brand in Albania, by quite a margin. The specific style of sedan pictured here is particularly common.
text_zh: **賓士** 是阿爾巴尼亞最受歡迎的汽車品牌，領先幅度相當大。圖中這種特定款式的轎車尤其常見。

text: The iconic **Stobie pole**, made of steel and concrete, is specific to South Australia. The [pole tops](https://goo.gl/maps/Le5eiGxw9bRT1UQJA) (trident or rotated letter “E”) are also unique.
NOTE: A few thousand of these poles can be found in other states, most notably Tasmania.
text_zh: 由鋼材與混凝土製成的標誌性 **Stobie 電線桿**是南澳州特有的。其[電線桿頂部](https://goo.gl/maps/Le5eiGxw9bRT1UQJA)（三叉戟狀或旋轉的字母「E」）也是獨一無二的。
備註：在其他州也可以找到數千根這種電線桿，最明顯的是塔斯馬尼亞。

text: The official language of Austria is **German**. The German language uses the special letters Ä, Ö, Ü and ß.

NOTE: The other majority German-speaking countries with coverage are Switzerland and Germany. In addition, German is spoken in [East Belgium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German-speaking_Community_of_Belgium) and the Italian province of [South Tyrol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Tyrol).
text_zh: 奧地利的官方語言是**德語**。德語使用特殊字母 Ä、Ö、Ü 和 ß。
註：其他具有街景覆蓋且主要使用德語的國家為瑞士和德國。此外，[比利時東部](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German-speaking_Community_of_Belgium)和義大利的[南蒂羅爾](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Tyrol)省也講德語。

text: Austrian **bus stop signs** contain a yellow and green circle with the letter **H**.
NOTE: This design is relatively unique in Europe. The only other country with similar bus stop signs is Germany.
text_zh: 奧地利的**公車站牌**包含一個黃綠相間的圓圈，中間帶有字母 **H**。
註：這種設計在歐洲相當獨特。唯一擁有類似公車站牌的國家是德國。

text: **Portuguese **is spoken in Brazil, as opposed to most Latin American countries which speak Spanish. Compared to Spanish, some essential differences are that Portuguese uses -ão rather than -ón, -ch/-lh instead of -ll and -nh instead of -ñ.
text_zh: 巴西使用**葡萄牙語**，與大多數講西班牙語的拉丁美洲國家不同。與西班牙語相比，一些主要差異是葡萄牙語使用 -ão 而非 -ón、-ch/-lh 代替 -ll，以及 -nh 代替 -ñ。

text: Markings on poles are used by the electricity companies to identify them. This pole ID is **long**, **yellow** **pole paint **with a black code. The ones that start with a letter are found in Bahia and Pernambuco.
text_zh: 電力公司會在電線桿上記號以供識別。這種電線桿編號是帶有黑色代碼的**長條**、**黃色** **電線桿塗漆 **。開頭為字母的編號可在巴伊亞州和伯南布哥州（Pernambuco）找到。

text: São Paulo has a **square, yellow** pole ID paint. It has three letters on top followed by two numbers, a black line, and four more numbers. The three letters represent the municipality within São Paulo, but are rarely visible.
text_zh: 聖保羅的電線桿上有**方形黃色**的編號噴漆。頂部有三個字母，後面跟著兩個數字、一條黑線和另外四個數字。這三個字母代表聖保羅州內的自治市，但很少能看清。

text: The English-speaking parts of Canada use **British English** spelling (e.g. centre; colour). In addition, Canada mostly uses the [metric system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system). For example, speed is measured in **kilometres **per hour.

NOTE: This is useful to distinguish between the US, where American English spelling and (usually) the [imperial system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units) are used. For example, the US measures speed in miles.
text_zh: 加拿大的英語區使用**英式英文**拼音（例如：centre、colour）。此外，加拿大主要採用[公制單位](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system)。例如，速度是以每小時**公里 **計算。
註：這很有助於區分美國，因為美國使用美式英文拼音以及（通常）[英制單位](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units)。例如，美國是以英里來計算速度。

text: French is the majority language in **Québec** and parts of **New Brunswick**.

NOTE: At the federal level, French has official status alongside English, so you can sometimes find bilingual signs in other parts of Canada. In addition, French is also spoken in several communities in Nova Scotia, Ontario and Manitoba.
text_zh: 法文是**魁北克省**以及**紐布倫斯威克省**部分地區的主要語言。
註：在聯邦層級，法文與英文同具官方語言地位，因此在加拿大其他地區有時也能找到雙語標誌。此外，新斯科細亞省、安大略省和曼尼托巴省的幾個社區也使用法文。

text: Stop signs with the word **‘Arrêt’ **are unique to Québec.
text_zh: 帶有 **‘Arrêt’** 字樣的停止標誌是魁北克特有的。

text: Stop signs with both **‘Stop’ and ‘Arrêt’** are most commonly found in New Brunswick.
NOTE: Such stop signs can rarely be found in other provinces.
text_zh: 同時印有 **「Stop」與「Arrêt」** 的 Stop 標誌最常見於紐布倫斯威克省。
註：此類 Stop 標誌極少出現在其他省份。

text: Like the stop signs, street signs in New Brunswick are also bilingual.
Though unlike the stop signs, bilingual street signs are found in other French minority areas of Canada.
text_zh: 與 Stop 標誌一樣，紐布倫斯威克省的路名牌也是雙語的。
不過與 Stop 標誌不同的是，雙語路名牌也可以在加拿大其他法文少數族群地區看到。

text: **Provincial flags** appear decently often. The [Fleurdelisé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_Quebec) of Québec in particular is very common.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **省旗**相當常出現。特別是魁北克的[百合花旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flag_of_Quebec)非常常見。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Acadia** is a French-speaking cultural region in the Canadian Maritimes without clearly defined borders. It is usually understood to at least include north and east New Brunswick, with some isolated communities in Nova Scotia and Prince Edward Island.

It has its own flag, which is a French-style tricolour with a yellow star in the blue band. It can be seen either flown or painted on [poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4VfcnD6JmdyFURQD8) in this region.
text_zh: **阿卡迪亞**是加拿大海洋省份中一個沒有明確邊界的法語文化區。通常理解為至少包含紐布倫斯威克省北部與東部，以及新斯科細亞省和愛德華王子島的一些孤立社區。
它有自己的旗幟，是帶有黃色星星在藍條紋上的法式三色旗。在該地區可以看見這面旗幟懸掛或繪製在[電線桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4VfcnD6JmdyFURQD8)上。

text: **French** is a Romance language that is closely related to languages like Catalan, Spanish and Italian. It uses these diacritics and special letters:
- Accent aigu: é
- Accent grave: à, è, ù
- Accent circonflexe: â, ê, î, ô, û
- Trema: ë, ï, ü, ÿ
- Ligature: œ
- [Cédille](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cedilla): ç with a small hook
In addition, the -ux suffix is only found in French.
NOTE: Other European countries with sizable francophone populations include Belgium, Luxembourg, Monaco and Switzerland.
text_zh: **法語**是一種羅曼語族語言，與加泰隆尼亞語、西班牙語和義大利語等語言密切相關。它使用這些附加符號和特殊字母：
- 鋭音符：é
- 重音符：à, è, ù
- 揚抑符：â, ê, î, ô, û
- 分音符：ë, ï, ü, ÿ
- 連字：œ
- [下加音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cedilla)：帶有小勾的 ç
此外，-ux 字尾只會出現在法語中。
註：其他法語人口較多的歐洲國家包含比利時、盧馬堡、摩納哥和瑞士。

text: The French word for street is “**rue**”.
text_zh: 法語中街道的詞是“**rue**”。

text: French car brands Peugeot, Renault and Citroën together make up almost half of all cars in France.
NOTE: These car brands are also common in linguistically related neighbouring countries.
text_zh: 法國汽車品牌標緻、雷諾和雪鐵龍合計佔了法國所有汽車的近一半。
注意：這些汽車品牌在語言相關的鄰國也很常見。

text: Each department has an assigned number to it, arranged mostly [alphabetically](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France#Current_departments). This is most useful in postal codes, consisting of 5 digits, the first two representing the department they’re in.
NOTE: the same regional codes are used inside the right blue strip on [licence plates](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hdSg7fcVKbUGPcjP8).
text_zh: 每個省份都有一個指定的編號，大多按[字母順序](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Departments_of_France#Current_departments)排列。這在郵遞區號中最有用，郵遞區號由 5 位數組成，前兩位數代表他們所在的省份。
注意：相同的區域代碼也用於[車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/hdSg7fcVKbUGPcjP8)右側的藍色條帶內。

text: Most departments have their own unique logo (formally called official flag), often containing stylized initials or the entire name. Notable infrastructure with department logos include [bus stops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7), [kilometre markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9), [trail banners](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7), [directional signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6) and [signbacks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6). Learning what each logo looks like is not recommended for beginners, but it can be helpful to know what they stand for when scanning.

You can find the full list of logos [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments), or see them projected onto a map [here](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png).
text_zh: 大多數省份都有自己獨特的標誌（正式稱為官方旗幟），通常包含風格化的縮寫或全名。帶有省份標誌的知名基礎設施包括[公車站](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7)、[公里標石](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9)、[步道標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7)、[方向標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6)和[標誌背面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6)。不建議初學者學習每個標誌長什麼樣子，但在掃描時了解它們代表什麼會很有幫助。

你可以在[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments)找到標誌的完整列表，或在[這裡](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png)查看它們在地圖上的投影。

text: A red and yellow logo with an [Occitan cross](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_cross) and vertical stripes is the official flag of the Occitanie region.

The rest of the regions also have [logos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#Regions), which appear less frequently. You can see them projected onto a map [here](https://i.imgur.com/DNYKa4L.png).
text_zh: 一個帶有[奧克西坦尼十字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_cross)和垂直條紋的紅黃相間標誌是奧克西坦尼大區的官方旗幟。
其餘的大區也有[標誌](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#Regions)，但出現頻率較低。你可以在[這裡](https://i.imgur.com/DNYKa4L.png)查看它們在地圖上的投影。

text: A flag made up of red and yellow stripes, based on [the Senyera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera), is the official flag and department logo of **Pyrénées-Orientales**. You will often find the pattern used in coats of arms on street signs.
NOTE: The flag of [Provence](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provence) looks similar, but with [vertical](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CWTzNJaQNoRJwEDeA) stripes instead.
text_zh: 一面由紅黃條紋組成、基於[塞涅拉旗](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Senyera)的旗幟，是**東比利牛斯省**的官方旗幟和省份標誌。你經常會在路標的徽章上看到這種圖案。
注意：[普羅旺斯](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Provence)的旗幟看起來很相似，但採用的是[垂直](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CWTzNJaQNoRJwEDeA)條紋。

text: Street signs in the metropolitan area of Paris often say the** name of the city**, which is generally atypical for street signs in France. The signs will often be made in a **modern design**, and many city names will be** river based**, notably named after Seine and Marne.
NOTE: This can be seen sporadically throughout the country, so consider other clues.
text_zh: 巴黎都會區的街道標誌通常會寫上**城市名稱**，這在法國的街道標誌中通常是不尋常的。這些標誌通常採用**現代設計**，且許多城市名稱將**基於河流**，特別是以塞納河和馬恩河命名。
注意：這在全國各地偶爾也能見到，因此請一併考慮其他線索。

text: France is home to many minority languages, 6 of which will be covered in this guide:
- **Alsatian**, a dialect of Alemannic German.
- **Basque**, the only European [language isolate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_isolate).
- **Breton**, a Celtic language.
- **Catalan, Corsican **and **Occitan**, Romance languages which are related to French.
However, French, legally the only official language, is dominant in all regions of the country, so don’t exclude highlighted regions when you’re placed in an all French round.
text_zh: 法國是許多少數民族語言的發源地，本指南將涵蓋其中 6 種：
- **亞爾薩斯語**（Alsatian），阿勒曼尼德語的一種方言。
- **巴斯克語**（Basque），歐洲唯一的[語言isolate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Language_isolate)。
- **布列塔尼語**（Breton），一種凱爾特語。
- **加泰隆尼亞語、科西嘉語**和**奧克語**（Catalan, Corsican and Occitan），與法語相關的羅曼語族語言。
然而，法語在法律上是唯一的官方語言，在全國所有地區都佔據主導地位，所以當你被分配到全法語回合時，不要排除標記的區域。

text: [**Breton**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breton_language) is a Celtic language, visually most similar to Welsh. Common letters include **d**, **k**, **w **and the letter** ñ**, which is not found in French. It is commonly found on the Breton peninsula, with bilingual street signs as east as [Rennes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SXA9tpudgXLcbpvJ7) and rarely [Nantes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/v9hAN6FqvpLekm5n6). The Breton word for street is straed**.**
text_zh: [**布列塔尼語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breton_language)是一種凱爾特語，視覺上與威爾斯語最為相似。常見的字母包括 **d**、**k**、**w** 以及法語中沒有的字母 **ñ**。它常見於布列塔尼半島，雙語路標向東可達[雷恩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SXA9tpudgXLcbpvJ7)，少數可達[南特](https://maps.app.goo.gl/v9hAN6FqvpLekm5n6)。布列塔尼語中街道的意思是 straed**。**

text: Towns with the **Plou-** prefix are concentrated in Northwestern Brittany.
text_zh: 帶有 **Plou-** 前綴的城鎮集中在西北部的布列塔尼。

text: [**Alsatian**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsatian_dialect), a dialect of German, is occasionally found in [Alsace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsace), a region that changed countries 4 times in modern history. Most bilingual street signs use some variation of gasse or strasse.
NOTE: Streets [containing German names](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeoLMxMiP1nPJuJD9) are also concentrated in this region, though not as consistently.
text_zh: 德語的一個方言[**阿爾薩斯語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsatian_dialect)偶爾會在[阿爾薩斯](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alsace)找到，這個地區在近代史上曾 4 次更換國家。大多數雙語街道招牌都會使用 gasse 或 strasse 的某些變體。
注意：[包含德文名稱](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HeoLMxMiP1nPJuJD9)的街道也集中在這個地區，雖然不像前者那麼一致。

text: [**Occitan**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_language) is a Romance language closely related to Catalan that’s sparsely concentrated in the South of France, most often found on street signs in big cities, and very rarely on [town entry signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J5Bj9ZSR2MfHAegg9). It can be divided into dialects, each using a slightly different word for street, all similar to Catalan “carrer”. For example, in Toulouse, you’ll find the Languedocian carrièra and in Avignon carriero, in the Provençal** **dialect.
Click [here](https://i.imgur.com/B8gX96p.png) for a more extensive infographic.
NOTE: The street sign designs pictured are also unique to the two cities respectively.
text_zh: [**奧克語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_language)是一種與加泰隆尼亞語密切相關的羅曼語族語言，稀疏地分佈在法國南部，最常出現在大城市的街道招牌上，極少數出現在[城鎮入口標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J5Bj9ZSR2MfHAegg9)上。它可以分為多種方言，每種方言對街道的稱呼略有不同，但都與加泰隆尼亞語的「carrer」相似。例如，在土魯斯你會看到朗格多克方言的 carrièra，而在亞維農則會看到普羅旺斯** **方言的 carriero。
點擊[這裡](https://i.imgur.com/B8gX96p.png)查看更詳細的資訊圖表。
注意：圖中顯示的街道招牌設計也分別是這兩座城市特有的。

text: Bilingual signs in [**Basque**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basque_language), a language isolate, are concentrated In the western half of the Pyrénées-Atlantiques department, bordering the Basque speaking regions in Spain. Common letters include K, X and Z. On directional signs, it’s written with a **thinner font**, which is unique within all minority languages in France.
The word for street is karrika, in contrast to “kalea” in the Spanish Basque country.
text_zh: [**巴斯克語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Basque_language)是一種孤立語言，其雙語招牌集中在庇里牛斯-大西洋省（Pyrénées-Atlantiques）的西部地區，與西班牙的巴斯克語地區接壤。常見的字母包括 K、X 和 Z。在方向指示牌上，它使用的是**較細的字體**，這在法國的所有少數族群語言中是獨一無二的。
街道的巴斯克語是 karrika，這與西班牙巴斯克地區的「kalea」形成對比。

text: On the island of Corsica, you may find bilingual signs in [**Corsican**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corsican_language), a Romance language that utilises many features found in Italian, like words almost always ending in vowels. In particular, the endings** u/iu/ju**, changed from o/io, are common in Corsican. Moreover, placenames will usually have an Italian origin.
text_zh: 在科西嘉島上，你可能會找到[**科西嘉語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corsican_language)的雙語招牌。這是一種羅曼語族語言，使用了許多義大利語的特徵，例如單字幾乎總是結尾於母音。特別是結尾為 **u/iu/ju**（由 o/io 轉變而來）在科西嘉語中很常見。此外，地名通常具有義大利語起源。

text: The far southern department **Pyrénées-Orientales**, also known as Catalunya Nord (Northern Catalonia), uses [**Catalan**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan_language) on their various signage.
It is closely related to both Spanish and French, with Ç being considerably more common than in French. The word for street is carrer.
text_zh: 最南部的**東庇里牛斯省**（Pyrénées-Orientales），也被稱為北加泰隆尼亞（Catalunya Nord），在其各種招牌上使用[**加泰隆尼亞語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catalan_language)。
它與西班牙語和法語都有密切關係，其中 Ç 比法語中常見得多。街道的詞是 carrer。

text: Knowing basic toponymy in France is crucial for regionguessing, particularly suffixes. This map shows one of the most common and useful endings, with rare exceptions. Other, extraordinarily rare suffixes can be found [here](/images/france/2_minortoponyms.png?).
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 了解法國的基本地名學對於地區猜測至關重要，特別是字尾。這張地圖顯示了最常見且最有用的字尾，只有少數例外。其他極其罕見的字尾可以在[這裡](/images/france/2_minortoponyms.png?)找到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Many French cities contain the name of the **river** they lay on, usually in the format **-sur-[river]**. On signage, sur are often [shortened to ˢ/](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KZQRgQ7Pszn6X79R6), in this case Chalonnes-sur-Loire (Chalonnes upon Loire). The picture shows five of the longest and therefore most common origins of river based names, but cities can bear the name of any river, regardless of length.

Similarly, city names containing [-sur-mer](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nKqfxeaX1hhikGeF8) (=on sea) or [-plage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6mbr4tT9J4CRaEAb8) (=beach)** **are found exclusively on the coast.
text_zh: 許多法國城市包含它們所在河流的**名稱**，通常格式為 **-sur-[river]**。在標誌上，sur 通常[縮寫為 ˢ/](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KZQRgQ7Pszn6X79R6)，在此例中為 Chalonnes-sur-Loire（盧瓦爾河畔沙洛訥）。圖片顯示了五個最長且因此最常見的基於河流名稱的起源，但城市可以承載任何河流的名稱，無論長短。
同樣地，包含 [-sur-mer](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nKqfxeaX1hhikGeF8)（=海濱）或 [-plage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6mbr4tT9J4CRaEAb8)（=海灘）**的地名**專門出現在海岸線上。

text: Indonesian licence plates are black with white letters. The letters usually appear as **three white sections** through the blur.
Commercial vehicles use yellow licence plates.
Plates in newer coverage can be [white](https://maps.app.goo.gl/41BknjygGkkbi1CJ6) too.
NOTE: Malaysian licence plates are also black, but generally have two white sections.
text_zh: 印尼車牌為黑色配白字。透過模糊效果，字母通常會呈現**三個白色區塊**。
商業車輛使用黃色車牌。
較新街景覆蓋中的車牌也可以是[白色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/41BknjygGkkbi1CJ6)的。
注意：馬來西亞車牌也是黑色的，但通常只有兩個白色區塊。

text: Indonesian can look very similar to Malaysian, however Indonesian has been influenced by **Dutch**, and Malaysian by English. These small changes in spelling may help differentiate the two.

An example is the word television in English, which translates to ‘televisi’ in Indonesian, similar to the Dutch word ‘televisie.’ In Malaysian, it translates to ‘televisyen’, more similar to English.
text_zh: 印尼語看起來可能非常類似馬來西亞語，但印尼語受過**荷蘭語**影響，而馬來西亞語則受英語影響。拼寫上的這些微小變化可能助於區分兩者。
一個例子是英語中的電視單字，在印尼語中翻譯為「televisi」，類似荷蘭語單字「televisie」。在馬來西亞語中，它翻譯為「televisyen」，更類似英語。

text: You can find the **cardinal directions** written on many addresses. They are as follows:
- North = Utara
- East = Timur
- South = Selatan
- West = Barat
- Central = Tengah
- Southeast = Tenggara
text_zh: 你可以在許多地址上找到寫著的**方位**。它們如下：
- 北 = Utara
- 東 = Timur
- 南 = Selatan
- 西 = Barat
- 中 = Tengah
- 東南 = Tenggara

text: Poles with a **support shaped like the letter A** are common in Kalimantan and the Nusa islands.
NOTE: A-frame poles can exist anywhere where the electrical wires are in a bend and need extra support. Use this tip with caution.
text_zh: 具有** A 字型支撐**的電線桿常見於加里曼丹和努沙登加拉群島。
注意：A 型電線桿可能會出現在電線轉彎且需要額外支撐的任何地方。請謹慎使用此提示。

text: **Architecture in Bali** is unique because it was influenced by old Balinese culture and Hinduism. The most important thing to look for are these [crown-like roof pinnacles](https://goo.gl/maps/9v5HBGbiGDczWKYn7), found everywhere in Bali. [Guardian statues](https://goo.gl/maps/CB1pcgrABdjsc3Y88) and [slit-drum towers](https://goo.gl/maps/xPNMsB3rqDjjWZi39) are common too. Andesite, a dark, volcanic rock, is a common building material in Bali. You can often see [gates](https://goo.gl/maps/StCdo1UxpSMXfA388), [walls](https://goo.gl/maps/KF7GweCfsicZyQpN7), and other [intricately carved ornaments](https://goo.gl/maps/9DHCZvKStsqSXG8RA) built from this material.
text_zh: **峇里島的建築**非常獨特，因為它受到古代峇里島文化和印度教的影響。需要尋找的最重要的事情是這些在峇里島隨處可見的[皇冠狀屋頂尖頂](https://goo.gl/maps/9v5HBGbiGDczWKYn7)。[守護神雕像](https://goo.gl/maps/CB1pcgrABdjsc3Y88)和[獨木鼓樓](https://goo.gl/maps/xPNMsB3rqDjjWZi39)也很常見。安山岩是一種深色的火山岩，是峇里島常見的建築材料。你經常可以看到用這種材料建造的[大門](https://goo.gl/maps/StCdo1UxpSMXfA388)、[牆壁](https://goo.gl/maps/KF7GweCfsicZyQpN7)和其他[雕刻精細的裝飾品](https://goo.gl/maps/9DHCZvKStsqSXG8RA)。

text: Indonesia is religiously a **Muslim **majority country, so seeing churches, and other Christian signs, is a good clue for these regions.
text_zh: 印尼在宗教上是**穆斯林**占多數的國家，因此看到教堂和其他基督教標誌，是辨識這些地區的好線索。

text: Italian is the most spoken language in Italy. It uses many double consonants, and typically has a very large number of i’s. You can also find ì, é and à. Most words will end with a vowel.
NOTE: The Italian word for street is ‘via’, and can be found on most street signs.
text_zh: 義大利語是義大利最常說的語言。它使用許多雙輔音，通常有非常大量的字母 i。你也可以找到 ì、é 和 à。大多數單字會以母音結尾。
注意：義大利語的街道是「via」，可以在大多數路標上找到。

text: Directional signs are **blue** with a **white arrow**. All letters on these signs will be **capitalised**.
text_zh: 指示標誌為**藍色**，帶有**白色箭頭**。這些標誌上的所有字母都將是**大寫**的。

text: Italian kilometre markers are white squares with a **roman numeral** on top and an arabic numeral on the bottom. The arabic numeral gives you the number of kilometres and the roman numeral gives you the number of hundred metres from the start of the road.
text_zh: 義大利公里標是白色方形，頂部有一個**羅馬數字**，底部有一個阿拉伯數字。阿拉伯數字提供你距離道路起點的公里數，羅馬數字提供你距離道路起點的百公尺數。

text: Italian road numbers will normally begin with the letters “SS”, “SR” or “SP”.
The second letter can be used to identify the type of road.
- "S" when it is a State road, so the number is unique within the country.
- "R" when it is a Regional road, so the number is unique to the region.
- "P" when it is a Provincial road, so the number is unique to the province.
text_zh: 義大利道路編號通常以字母「SS」、「SR」或「SP」開頭。
第二個字母可用於識別道路類型。
- 當它是國道時為「S」，因此該編號在全國是唯一的。
- 當它是省道時為「R」，因此該編號對該地區是唯一的。
- 當它是省道時為「P」，因此該編號對該省是唯一的。

text: Each Italian region has its own unique flag.
text_zh: 每個義大利大區都有自己獨特的旗幟。

text: The region of South Tyrol has a German majority, and as such uses **German bilingual signs**.
text_zh: 南提洛（South Tyrol）大區擁有德國人多數人口，因此使用**德語雙語標誌**。

text: **French** can be seen on signs in the Aosta Valley. Most notably, street signs often use both the Italian word “via” and the French word “rue”.
text_zh: **法語**可以在瓦萊達奧斯塔（Aosta Valley）的標誌上看到。最顯著的是，街道標誌通常同時使用義大利語單字「via」和法語單字「rue」。

text: Close to the Slovenian border you can find **Slovene bilingual signs**.
text_zh: 靠近斯洛維尼亞邊境，你可以找到**斯洛維尼亞語雙語標誌**。

text: Post codes in Kenya can be identified by [signs in the format PO BOX XXX-YYYZZ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zkoZ8sYzmTGiRivA6), where the number YYY (usually 3 digits but sometimes 0) corresponds to a post code. This is the number which can be used to narrow down your guess. Often, the name of the city is listed after the PO BOX.
NOTE: You can sometimes see [PO BOX without the second number](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sNta3QHeJpwVVgoDA) after the hyphen which is not helpful.

_You can click on the image to enlarge it. Here is a _[quiz](https://www.super-duper.fr/quiz2024/areacodes.php?country=POST_KE&language=en&tile=gmaps&border=thin&difficulty=false&timer=false&gmaplng=en)_ to help practice Kenyan post codes_
text_zh: 肯亞的郵遞區號可透過[格式為 PO BOX XXX-YYYZZ 的標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zkoZ8sYzmTGiRivA6)來辨識，其中數字 YYY（通常為 3 位數，但有時為 0）對應到郵遞區號。這個數字可用來縮小你的猜測範圍。通常 PO BOX 後面會列出城市名稱。
注意：有時候你會看到連字號後面[沒有第二個數字的 PO BOX](https://maps.app.goo.gl/sNta3QHeJpwVVgoDA)，這對判斷沒有幫助。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。這裡有一個_[測驗](https://www.super-duper.fr/quiz2024/areacodes.php?country=POST_KE&language=en&tile=gmaps&border=thin&difficulty=false&timer=false&gmaplng=en)_可協助練習肯亞郵遞區號_

text: Direction signs in North Macedonia are typically **yellow **with** biscriptal text**: town names are written in both Latin and Cyrillic script.
NOTE: Serbia, Slovenia, Croatia, and Montenegro have similar signs. Serbia is the only one that will have biscriptal text though.
text_zh: 北馬其頓的指示標誌通常是**黃色**且帶有**雙文字系統**：城鎮名稱同時以拉丁字母和斯拉夫字母（西里爾字母）書寫。
備註：塞爾維亞、斯洛維尼亞、克羅埃西亞和蒙特內哥羅都有類似的標誌。不過，塞爾維亞是唯一會使用雙文字系統的國家。

text: Macedonian is a Slavic language which uses the **Cyrillic** script. Road signs have Latin on them too, although most other signs are fully in Cyrillic.
The letters ‘**Ѓ**’ and ‘**Ќ**’ are unique to Macedonian. ‘Љ’, ‘Њ’, and ‘Џ’ are only in Serbian and Macedonian.
text_zh: 馬其頓語是一種使用**西里爾字母**的斯拉夫語言。道路標誌上也有拉丁字母，不過大多數其他標誌完全使用西里爾字母。
字母「**Ѓ**」和「**Ќ**」是馬其頓語所獨有的。「Љ」、「Њ」和「Џ」則僅見於塞爾維亞語和馬其頓語中。

text: Each city has its own **city-specific **posters with public obituaries. They are commonly found on utility poles.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個城市都有其**城市特定的**張貼公共訃聞海報。它們通常可以在電線桿上找到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Obituaries in Kumanovo are the most distinct. They are the only obituaries to have a** thick light blue border**.
text_zh: 庫馬諾沃的訃聞最為獨特。它們是唯一擁有**粗淺藍色邊框**的訃聞。

text: Obituaries in Bitola are **horizontal** and can be either light or dark blue. The cross is** in-between **the border, leaving a gap in the rectangle.
text_zh: 比托拉的訃聞是**水平的**，可以是淺藍色或深藍色。十字架位於邊框**中間**，在長方形中留下一個缺口。

text: Obituaries in Ohrid are **horizontal** and either red or blue. The cross is underneath the border, which is unique to Ohrid when the obituary is red.
text_zh: 奧赫里德的訃聞是**水平的**，且為紅色或藍色。十字架位於邊框下方，當訃聞是紅色時，這是奧赫里德特有的。

text: Obituaries in Strumica are vertical and blue. They are the only obituaries to have an **intricate pattern** in the corner of the poster.
text_zh: 斯特魯米察的訃聞是垂直且藍色的。它們是唯一在海報角落擁有**繁複圖案**的訃聞。

text: Obituaries in Veles are **vertical and blue**. Veles has the largest variety of obituaries, but will never have the pattern in the corner like the ones seen in Strumica. They are also the only city that will have the cross **above the border** when blue.
text_zh: 韋利士的訃聞是**垂直且藍色的**。韋利士擁有最多樣化的訃聞，但絕不會有像斯特魯米察那種在角落的圖案。當它們是藍色時，也是唯一會將十字架置於**邊框上方**的城市。

text: Obituaries in Prilep are vertical and black. The border **does not **go completely around the poster, which makes it easy to distinguish.
text_zh: 普里萊普的訃聞是垂直且黑色的。邊框**並未**完全繞著海報一圈，這使得它很容易辨識。

text: Obituaries in Tetovo are vertical and black. There are 2 main types found in the city, one with the cross **above** the border and one with a thick cross **in-between** the border.
text_zh: 泰托沃的訃聞是垂直且黑色的。城裡主要有2種類型，一種的十字架在邊框**上方**，另一種則帶有粗十字架在邊框**中間**。

text: The Norwegian language contains the special letters Æ, Ø and Å.
NOTE: The special letters found in Norwegian can also be found in some of the other Nordic languages:
- Danish uses Æ, Ø and Å.
- Swedish uses Å, but not Æ or Ø. Norwegian also uses more E’s than Swedish, while Swedish uses more A’s instead. Norwegian uses “kk” where Swedish uses “ck”.
- Icelandic uses Æ, but not Ø or Å.
- Finnish uses Å, although it is viewed as a Swedish letter.
text_zh: 挪威語包含特殊字母 Æ、Ø 和 Å。
注意：挪威語中的特殊字母也可以在其他一些北歐語言中找到：
- 丹麥語使用 Æ、Ø 和 Å。
- 瑞典語使用 Å，但不使用 Æ 或 Ø。挪威語也比瑞典語使用更多 E，而瑞典語則改用更多 A。挪威語在瑞典語使用 “ck” 的地方使用 “kk”。
- 冰島語使用 Æ，但不使用 Ø 或 Å。
- 芬蘭語使用 Å，儘管它被視為瑞典字母。

text: Small, **wide black pole plates**, with a single line of letters and digits, can be found in southeastern Norway.
text_zh: 小型、**寬版黑色桿牌**（帶有一行字母和數字）可以在挪威東南部找到。

text: Pole markings with **yellow vertical numbers** are commonly found in northern coastal Peru and Tacna.

Oftentimes, but not always, they will be accompanied by a horizontal pole marking starting with a 2 or 3 letter code corresponding to a city. For example, this horizontal sticker starts with CH for Chimbote.

NOTE: you can further divide the region based on the number of digits and the actual numbers on the pole marking. See [this document](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rMBXs3_grdmPBdzT1fSfkj-MEnagQylqJnlbqOXBwkE/edit) for details.
text_zh: 帶有**黃色垂直數字**的電線桿標記常見於祕魯北部沿海地區和塔克納。
通常（但不總是），它們會伴隨著一個水平電線桿標記，以對應城市的 2 或 3 個字母代碼開頭。例如，這個水平貼紙以代表欽博托（Chimbote）的 CH 開頭。
注意：你可以根據位數和電線桿標記上的實際數字進一步劃分該地區。詳情請參閱[這份文件](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rMBXs3_grdmPBdzT1fSfkj-MEnagQylqJnlbqOXBwkE/edit)。

text: These black or white boxes are commonly seen on utility poles. Most of the time they feature a three letter abbreviation of the municipality you are in. The abbreviations will either have all three letters stand for the municipality, or the first two letters will abbreviate the municipality while the third letter indicates the province.
In the first image the "GMI" and "GMU" stands for the town of Gamu in the province of Isabela while the second image the "BGE" stands for the town of Bangued.
NOTE: Most towns do not have any standardised abbreviation so you might find many different abbreviations for the same place.
text_zh: 這些黑色或白色箱子經常出現在電線桿上。大多數時候，它們上面會有你所在自治市的三個字母縮寫。這些縮寫要嘛全部三個字母都代表自治市，要嘛前兩個字母代表自治市，而第三個字母代表省份。
在第一張圖片中，「GMI」和「GMU」代表伊莎貝拉省的加姆鎮（Gamu），而在第二張圖片中，「BGE」代表班格德鎮（Bangued）。
注意：大多數城鎮沒有標準化的縮寫，因此你可能會在同一個地方發現許多不同的縮寫。

text: The Russian language uses the **Cyrillic script**, and contains the special letters Ы, Э, Ё and Ъ.
Ё is also used in Mongolian and Ъ is used in Bulgarian.

NOTE: You may rarely come across Russian in both [Ukraine](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.7466337,33.3598742,3a,15y,252.53h,96.14t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1snFUnRbez3yFUVjnKG9azVg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and eastern [Estonia](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.3779623,28.1969594,3a,15y,61.93h,93.19t,1.18r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLI0Eu3YxRqFjCr2pUN2tAw!2e0!5s20230901T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 俄羅斯語使用**西里爾字母**，並包含特殊字母 Ы、Э、Ё 和 Ъ。
Ё 也用於蒙古語，而 Ъ 用於保加利亞語。

注意：你可能很少在[烏克蘭](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.7466337,33.3598742,3a,15y,252.53h,96.14t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1snFUnRbez3yFUVjnKG9azVg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)和東[愛沙尼亞](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.3779623,28.1969594,3a,15y,61.93h,93.19t,1.18r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sLI0Eu3YxRqFjCr2pUN2tAw!2e0!5s20230901T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)兩者中遇到俄羅斯語。

text: The Russian word for street is **улица** (ulitsa), sometimes abbreviated **ул.** (ul.).
NOTE: Bulgarian and most other Slavic languages also use улица / ulica. The Ukrainian word however is вулиця (vulytsya), abbreviated вул. (vul.).
text_zh: 俄羅斯語的街道一詞是 **улица** (ulitsa)，有時簡寫為 **ул.** (ul.)。
注意：保加利亞語和大多數其他斯拉夫語言也使用 улица / ulica。然而，烏克蘭語的單詞是 вулиця (vulytsya)，簡寫為 вул. (vul.)。

text: The Russian word for city is **город** (gorod), abbreviated **г.** (g.).
NOTE: The Ukrainian word is місто (misto), abbreviated м. (m.).
text_zh: 俄羅斯語的城市一詞是 **город** (gorod)，簡寫為 **г.** (g.)。
注意：烏克蘭語單詞是 місто (misto)，簡寫為 м. (m.)。

text: Japanese-made cars with the **steering wheel on the right** become more common the further east you go, generally starting around Novosibirsk.
text_zh: 日本製造的**右駕**車輛越往東走越常見，通常從新西伯利亞一帶開始出現。

text: Some republics of Russia with minority languages use bilingual town entry and directional signs, such as in Bashkortostan and Tatarstan displaying Bashkir and Tatar respectively.
text_zh: 一些擁有少數族群語言的俄羅斯共和國會使用雙語的城鎮入口與方向標誌，例如巴什科爾托斯坦和韃靼斯坦分別顯示巴什基爾語和韃靼語。

text: **Town names** written in both the Cyrillic and **Latin** alphabets are common near the Baltic border and around Moscow, and to a lesser extent in federal subjects on the Finnish border.
text_zh: 同時以斯拉夫字母與**拉丁**字母書寫的**城鎮名稱**在波羅的海邊界與莫斯科周邊很常見，在芬蘭邊境的聯邦主體中則較少見。

text: While mosques can be found everywhere in Russia, they are by far most common in areas with a Muslim majority, mainly in much of south Russia as well as Tatarstan and Bashkortostan.
text_zh: 雖然清真寺在俄羅斯各地都能找到，但它們在穆斯林占多數的地區（主要是俄羅斯南部大部分地區以及韃靼斯坦和巴什科爾托斯坦）絕對是最常見的。

text: Street names often have a two-letter code, which tells you the district you are in.
text_zh: 街道名稱通常帶有兩個字母代碼，可告訴你你所在的行政區。

text: Lampposts along many national roads will have the road number painted in black letters. Below that, you will find the lamp number, which generally, but not always, increases the further from Kigali you get.
text_zh: 許多國道沿線的燈桿會用黑色字體漆上道路編號。在其下方可以找到燈桿編號，通常（但非絕對）距離基加利越遠，編號就越大。

text: Serbian is a Slavic language which uses both the **Cyrillic** and Latin script. These letters are unique to Serbian:
- Ђ ђ
- Ћ ћ
These letters are found in Serbian and Macedonian:
- Љ љ
- Њ њ
- Џ џ
text_zh: 塞爾維亞語是一種斯拉夫語言，同時使用**斯拉夫字母（Cyrillic）**與拉丁字母。以下這些字母是塞爾維亞語獨有的：
- Ђ ђ
- Ћ ћ
這些字母則同時見於塞爾維亞語和馬其頓語：
- Љ љ
- Њ њ
- Џ џ

text: When written in the **Latin** script, Serbian uses the special letters Č, Ć, Đ, Š and Ž. Note that all of these letters may also be found in Croatian and Montenegrin.
text_zh: 當使用**拉丁**字母書寫時，塞爾維亞語會使用特殊的字母 Č、Ć、Đ、Š 和 Ž。請注意，所有這些字母也可能出現在克羅埃西亞語和蒙特內哥羅語中。

text: **Bilingual signs** with Serbian alongside Hungarian can be seen in northern Vojvodina, where there is a Hungarian majority.
text_zh: 在匈牙利族人口佔多數的北部伏伊伏丁那，可以看到並列塞爾維亞語與匈牙利語的**雙語標誌**。

text: Poles with 3 bars forming the letter **‘A’**, with the bottom insulators being attached at the edges of a horizontal bar, can be found almost exclusively in Western Cape, and rarely in bordering provinces.
text_zh: 具有 3 根橫桿形成**「A」**字形、且底部絕緣子連接在水平橫桿兩端的電線桿，幾乎僅能在西開普省找到，在鄰近省份則非常罕見。

text: On top of the language, the Portuguese influence can also be seen in infrastructure, such as ladder poles and pedestrian signs with the same design as in Portugal.
text_zh: 除了語言之外，葡萄牙的影響也能在基礎設施中看到，例如與葡萄牙相同設計的階梯電線桿和行人標誌。

text: Some wooden poles are painted **blue **on the bottom. You can also read the letters **CST **on them.
text_zh: 有些木製電線桿底部漆成**藍色**。你也可以在上面讀到字母**CST**。

text: Many poles in Taiwan feature these **blue plaques** with strings of letters and numbers that act as precise coordinates.
For an example of how to read the plaques in-game, the only thing that is useful here is the string “E3264”. “BE08” can further narrow down the position but is not practical in-game.
“E” refers to the 50x80km rectangle from this map.
“3264” means that within the rectangle, we are 32% eastward and 64% northward.
[This article](https://wiki.osgeo.org/wiki/Taiwan_Power_Company_grid#1.C3.971m) explains how the string “BE08” can be further used to narrow down the exact coordinates of the telephone pole.
text_zh: 台灣許多電線桿上有這種**藍色標牌**，上面的英數字串其實是精確的座標編碼。
以實戰判讀為例，真正有用的只有「E3264」這串；「BE08」雖然能再縮小範圍，但在遊戲中不實用。
「E」代表此圖中那塊 50×80 公里的方格。
「3264」代表在該方格內，位置在東向 32%、北向 64% 處。
[這篇文章](https://wiki.osgeo.org/wiki/Taiwan_Power_Company_grid#1.C3.971m)說明如何進一步用「BE08」推算出電線桿的精確座標。

text: Street signs in Bursa are **green**, and generally have slightly **extruded letters**, meaning the signs are not completely flat.
NOTE: Several other types of infrastructure in Bursa, such as [fences](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7) and [guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8), may also be coloured green.
text_zh: 布爾薩的街道標誌為 **綠色**，且通常帶有微幅 **凸出的字體**，這意味著標誌並非完全平坦。
註：布爾薩的其他幾種基礎設施（例如[圍欄](https://goo.gl/maps/EHzDyAUKLCQySbyB7)與[護欄](https://goo.gl/maps/nF72j1rxibsT8weR8)）也可能漆成綠色。

text: The US uses **American English** spelling (e.g. center, color).

In addition, the US primarily uses the [imperial system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units) for measurements. For example, speed and distance are measured in **miles**. You will also often see feet and inches on signs, indicating the height of bridges.

NOTE: This is useful to distinguish between the English-speaking parts of Canada, where British English spelling and (usually) the [metric system](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system) are used. For example, Canada measures speed in kilometres.
text_zh: 美國使用**美式英語**拼寫（例如 center、color）。
此外，美國主要使用[英制單位](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_units)來進行測量。例如，速度和距離都是以**英里**來計算。你也會經常在標誌上看到用來標示橋樑高度的英尺和英寸。
注意：這有助於區分英語系的加拿大地區，因為當地使用英式拼法，且（通常）使用[公制系統](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metric_system)。例如，加拿大是以公里來測量速度。

text: **Snowplowable raised pavement markers** can only be found on highways in the eastern states shown in the image. They are built into the road and somewhat resemble the letter H.
text_zh: **除雪機專用突起路標**僅見於圖片中所示的東部各州高速公路上。它們內嵌於道路中，外形有點像英文字母 H。

text: Wisconsin and Missouri are the only two states that use a **lettering system** (A - ZZZ) for their county highways. Wisconsin signs typically have the word ‘county’ above the letter, while Missouri signs typically do not. The borders of the signs also vary slightly.
text_zh: 威斯康辛州和密蘇里州是僅有的兩個在其郡道使用**字母系統**（A - ZZZ）的州。威斯康辛州的標誌通常在字母上方有「county」一詞，而密蘇里州的標誌通常沒有。標誌的邊框也略有不同。

text: **Catalan** is the main language in Andorra. It is a Romance language that is closely related to Spanish and French.

If you are unfamiliar with Romance languages, it can be hard to distinguish between Catalan and Spanish. If you see **i** instead of **y** (“and” in English), it is Catalan. In addition, more Catalan words end with consonants.
NOTE: The Catalan language is also used in eastern Spain: in Catalonia, the Valencian community and the Balearic islands.
text_zh: **加泰隆尼亞語**是安道爾的主要語言。它是一種羅曼語系語言，與西班牙語和法語密切相關。
如果你不熟悉羅曼語系語言，可能會很難區分加泰隆尼亞語和西班牙語。如果你看到**i**而不是**y**（英文的「和」），那就是加泰隆尼亞語。此外，更多加泰隆尼亞語單字以子音結尾。
注意：加泰隆尼亞語也在西班牙東部使用：在加泰隆尼亞、瓦倫西亞自治區和巴利亞利群島。

text: Roads that start with the letter **‘C’ **are only found in Victoria and Tasmania. In addition, South Australia has some C roads near the border with Victoria.
NOTE: Since these are smaller and less major roads, Generation 1 or 2 is common.
text_zh: 以字母 **‘C’ **開頭的公路僅見於維多利亞州與塔斯馬尼亞。此外，南澳州在與維多利亞州接壤的邊境附近也有一些 C 級公路。
備註：由於這些是較小且非主要的道路，因此常見 Generation 1 或 2 相機世代。

text: Street signs in the Azores are almost exclusively painted ceramic tiles, with blue letters and, typically, a decorative pattern around the edge.
text_zh: 亞速群島的路牌幾乎清一色是彩繪磁磚，帶有藍字，邊緣通常有裝飾花紋。

text: The Bengali script features a continuous **horizontal line** at the top of each word. It has a similar look to [Devanagari](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devanagari) (Hindi and Nepali), however it can usually be recognised by the many letters featuring triangular shapes.
NOTE: Bengali is an official language in Bangladesh and parts of eastern India.
text_zh: 孟加拉文字的特徵是每個單詞上方都有一條連續的**水平線**。它看起來與[天城體](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devanagari)（印地語和尼泊爾語）相似，但通常可以透過許多帶有三角形特徵的字母來識別。
註：孟加拉語是孟加拉以及印度東部部分地區的官方語言。

text: Signs will be in Belarusian or Russian. Both languages use the Cyrillic alphabet.
NOTE: The letters ў and і are not found in Russian.
text_zh: 指示牌會使用白俄羅斯語或俄語。兩種語言都使用西里爾字母。
備註：字母 ў 和 і 在俄語中看不到。

text: The Minsk centre street signs are **sea-green**, and can be seen almost everywhere.
NOTE: If you are close enough to the sign, you can make out the Cyrillic letters “вул (vul)”, the Belarusian name for “street”.
text_zh: 明斯克市中心的路牌是**海藍綠色**，幾乎隨處可見。
備註：如果你足夠靠近路牌，可以辨認出西里爾字母「вул (vul)」，這是白俄羅斯語中「街」的意思。

text: Belgium uses these **red** water hydrants signs with the letter **H **on top.
NOTE: You can also find these in Germany.
text_zh: 比利時使用這種**紅色**消防栓標誌，頂部帶有字母 **H**。
備註：你在德國也能看到這些。

text: Belgium has 3 official languages.
- **Dutch **(Flemish), spoken in **Flanders**, the Northern part of Belgium. There is an abundance of letters and combinations like z, w, ee and ij.
- **French **(Walloon), spoken in **Wallonia**, the Southern part of Belgium. You can see letters like ç, é, è and à.
- **German**, spoken in **Ostbelgien**, a small region in the east of the country. You can see letters like ä, ü, ö and ß.
text_zh: 比利時有 3 種官方語言。
- **荷蘭語**（佛萊明語），用於比利時北部的**佛萊明大區**（Flanders）。有大量的字母和組合，如 z、w、ee 和 ij。
- **法語**（瓦隆語），用於比利時南部的**瓦隆大區**（Wallonia）。你可以看到像 ç、é、è 和 à 這樣的字母。
- **德語**，使用於該國東部的小區域**東比利時**。你可以看到像是 ä、ü、ö 和 ß 等字母。

text: **Dzongkha **is an official language in Bhutan and has **unique-looking** letters.
NOTE: On street view, these letters can only be found in Bhutan.
text_zh: **宗喀語**是不丹的官方語言，擁有**外觀獨特**的字母。
注意：在街景上，這些字母只能在不丹看到。

text: Signs in Botswana are usually in **English**. Most town names, however, are derived from any of the indigenous languages spoken in the country.
NOTE: The Afrikaans language, which is closely related to Dutch and common in South Africa, is very rare in Botswana. You will almost never find Afrikaans place names.
text_zh: 波札那的標誌通常使用**英文**。然而，大多數城鎮名稱是源自該國所使用的某種原住民語言。
註：南非語（Afrikaans，與荷蘭語密切相關且在南非很常見）在波札那非常罕見。你幾乎不會看到南非語的地名。

text: Each Brazilian state has a **two-letter acronym**. These show up most prominently in the numbers of state roads (found on kilometre markers). They can also be found in other contexts however.

The state acronyms show up when you zoom out a little bit on Google maps, which is also possible in the minimap while in-game. However, for quick and or competitive games, it can be very useful to learn them by heart anyway, as this can help a lot with eliminating scanning time.
text_zh: 巴西的每個州都有一個**兩個字母的縮寫**。這些最常出現在州道編號（位於公里標誌上）中。然而，它們也可以在其他語境中看到。
在 Google 地圖稍微縮小一點時可以看到各州的縮寫，在遊戲內的縮小地圖中也可以看到。然而，對於快速或競技比賽來說，把它們記熟依然非常有用，因為這能大幅減少在地圖上搜尋的時間。

text: Bulgaria mainly uses the **Cyrillic alphabet**. However, a lot of signs will also have the Latin alphabet.
The letter “Ъ” is only found in Bulgarian and Russian, although it is fairly uncommon in Russian.
text_zh: 保加利亞主要使用**西里爾字母**。然而，許多標誌上也會有拉丁字母。
字母「Ъ」只出現在保加利亞文和俄文中，不過它在俄文中相當罕見。

text: The Bulgarian word for street is **улица** (ulitsa), sometimes abbreviated **ул.** (ul.).
NOTE: In older street signs seeing only Cyrillic is more common.
Russia also uses улица/ulitsa.
text_zh: 保加利亞文中的街道一詞是 **улица** (ulitsa)，有時簡寫為 **ул.** (ul.)。
注意：在較舊的路標上，只看到西里爾字母更為常見。
俄羅斯也使用 улица/ulitsa。

text: Bulgarian directional signs are blue, arrow-shaped, and use both the **Cyrillic and Latin** alphabet. Importantly, even if you are far away and cannot decipher the script, you can still see that the sign has two lines of text instead of one.
text_zh: 保加利亞的方向指示牌是藍色箭頭形，並同時使用**西里爾和拉丁**字母。重要的是，即使你身在遠處看不清文字，你仍能看出指示牌有兩行文字而非一行。

text: Town entry signs have a simple white design and also use both the Cyrillic and Latin alphabet. Like with the directional signs, the two lines of text are obvious, even when seen from far away.
text_zh: 城鎮入口標誌採用簡單的白色設計，同樣同時使用西里爾和拉丁字母。與方向指示牌一樣，即使從遠處看，兩行文字也很明顯。

text: Licence plates are **white** with **blue** letters. The blue sheen of the letters can be hard to see through the blur, and the plates might appear as plain white.
Plates on government vehicles are [green](https://goo.gl/maps/Y5GJLe2TPsuKVnts5).
text_zh: 車牌是**白色**的，帶有**藍色**字母。字母的藍色光澤在模糊處理後可能很難看清，車牌看起來可能就像純白色。
公務車輛的車牌是[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/Y5GJLe2TPsuKVnts5)。

text: **Khmer **is the official language of Cambodia. It has its own unique script, which is very distinct and recognizable. In most fonts, letters have an intricate, curvy look.
Khmer can look fairly different depending on the font used. A compilation of what this script looks like in street view can be [found here](/images/cambodia/cambo_script.png).
NOTE: The Thai and Lao scripts look similar, but the letters tend to have a less intricate look. However, some simplified Khmer fonts can look a bit like Thai and Lao.
text_zh: **高棉語**是柬埔寨的官方語言。它有自己獨特的文字，非常獨特且容易辨認。在大多數字型中，字母具有錯綜複雜的優美曲線外觀。
根據使用的字型不同，Khmer 看起來可能相當不一樣。這份文字在街景中的樣貌整理可以[點此查看](/images/cambodia/cambo_script.png)。
注意：Thai 與 Lao 的文字看起來很像，但字母通常沒那麼繁複。不過，有些簡化的 Khmer 字型看起來會有點像 Thai 和 Lao。

text: Chile uses a memorable regional road naming system, where the first letter increases between [A](https://goo.gl/maps/5sCeUaH9QXJVz6vt9) and [Y](https://goo.gl/maps/gD4ACFHPsD4bqpC37) from **north to south**. For more information on specific regions, see [here](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/chile?pli=1).
text_zh: 智利採用了一套令人印象深刻的區域道路命名系統，其中首字母從**北到南**在 [A](https://goo.gl/maps/5sCeUaH9QXJVz6vt9) 到 [Y](https://goo.gl/maps/gD4ACFHPsD4bqpC37) 之間遞增。有關特定地區的更多資訊，請參見[此處](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/chile?pli=1)。

text: Colombia uses two types of kilometre markers: a tall green version with the letters “**Pr**” at the top, and the traditional stone marker with black lettering. Both designs are unique to the country.

NOTE: The first two digits at the bottom indicate the road number. In this case, the road number is 90. The last two digits indicate the section of the road, which increase west to east on even numbered highways, and south to north on odd numbered highways.You can use this [resource](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anexo:Carreteras_nacionales_de_Colombia) to help identify each section.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞使用兩種型態的公里標：頂部帶有字母「**Pr**」的高大綠色版本，以及帶有黑色字體的傳統石碑標。這兩種設計都是該國獨有的。
註：底部的頭兩位數表示道路編號。在這種情況下，道路編號是 90。最後兩位數表示道路的路段，在雙號高速公路上由西向東遞增，在單號高速公路上由南向台北遞增。你可以使用這個[資源](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anexo:Carreteras_nacionales_de_Colombia)來幫助識別每個路段。

text: Like in most of Latin America, **Spanish** is the official language of Costa Rica.
NOTE: In Brazil, they speak Portuguese.
text_zh: 就像大多數拉丁美洲國家一樣，**西班牙語**是哥斯大黎加的官方語言。
注意：在巴西，他們說葡萄牙語。

text: Taxis in Costa Rica are [red](https://maps.app.goo.gl/inEA3C7FKWcQ1Sqq5), featuring yellow triangles on the sides and top containing the city/town name as well as a letter code denoting the province.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加的計程車是[紅色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/inEA3C7FKWcQ1Sqq5)的，兩側和頂部都有黃色三角形，裡面包含城市/城鎮名稱以及表示省份的字母代碼。

text: Croatian is a **Slavic** language. It is always written in the Latin alphabet. ‘IJE’ is common in Croatian whereas Serbian uses only ‘E’ instead.
NOTE: The Slovene language also features a lot of ‘J’s. Serbian and Montenegrin are also very similar, but Serbia and Montenegro use both Latin and Cyrillic script.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞語是一種**斯拉夫**語言。它一律以拉丁字母書寫。克羅埃西亞語中常見「IJE」，而塞爾維亞語則僅使用「E」來替代。
備註：斯洛維尼亞語也包含大量的「J」。塞爾維亞語和蒙特內哥羅語也非常相似，但塞爾維亞和蒙特內哥羅同時使用拉丁字母與斯拉夫字母。

text: Stickers with the letters **HR **can be found on Croatian cars. HR stands for Hrvatska, the Croatian name for Croatia.
NOTE: These were mainly used before EU plates were introduced, meaning they will be less common in Generation 4.
text_zh: 帶有字母**HR **的貼紙可以在克羅埃西亞的車輛上找到。HR 代表 Hrvatska，也就是克羅埃西亞的克羅埃西亞語名稱。
注意：這些主要是在歐盟車牌引進之前使用，這意味著它們在第四代中較不常見。

text: Cyprus uses the Greek and English languages. Greek has a unique alphabet not used in any other language. It shares similarities with both the Latin and [Cyrillic](https://www.plonkit.net/images/greece/greece_cyrillic.png) alphabets, however the lower case letters generally have softer shapes than the Cyrillic letters.
NOTE: It goes without saying, but Greece also uses the Greek alphabet.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯使用希臘語和英語。希臘語有一套其他任何語言都沒有的獨特字母。它與拉丁字母和[斯拉夫字母](https://www.plonkit.net/images/greece/greece_cyrillic.png)都有相似之處，但小寫字母通常比斯拉夫字母具有更柔和的形狀。
注意：不用說，希臘也使用希臘字母。

text: Czech and Slovak are mutually intelligible Slavic languages with several similarities such as acute accents above vowels (á, é, í, ó, ú, ý). However, they both have some distinct letters:
- Czech uses the letters **Ř**, **Ě** and **Ů**;
- Slovak uses the letters Ľ, Ô, Ä, Ŕ and Ĺ.
NOTE: Acute accents on vowels are not found in [South Slavic languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Slavic_languages).
text_zh: 捷克語和斯洛伐克語是互通的斯拉夫語言，有幾個相似之處，例如母音上方的尖音符（á, é, í, ó, ú, ý）。然而，它們各自有一些獨特的字母：
- 捷克語使用字母 **Ř**、**Ě** 和 **Ů**；
- 斯洛伐克語使用字母 Ľ、Ô、Ä、Ŕ 和 Ĺ。
注意：[南斯拉夫語言](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Slavic_languages)中沒有母音尖音符。

text: The most common type of street sign in Czechia are **bright red** signs, which can either be wide and stuck on walls, or thin and attached to [signs posts](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA). Note that other street signs do occur in some areas, most notably in [Brno](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). Similarly designed [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs are also fairly common.

Furthermore, the Czech word for street is “ulice”, unlike most Slavic languages which use “ulica”. This word is usually omitted, but finding “ulice” on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9) is still possible.
NOTE: [Slovakia](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8) typically uses white street signs with a red border and blue text.
text_zh: 捷克最常見的街道標誌是**亮紅色**標誌，可以是寬版並貼在牆上，或是窄版並固定在[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA)上。請注意，某些地區也會出現其他顏色的街道標誌，最明顯的是在[布爾諾](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。類似設計的[藍色](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌也相當常見。
此外，捷克語中的「街道」是「ulice」，這與大多數使用「ulica」的斯拉夫語言不同。這個字通常會被省略，但在[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9)上還是找得到「ulice」。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8)通常使用帶有紅邊和藍字白色街道標誌。

text: **Danish** is a North Germanic language that is closely related to Swedish and Norwegian. The Danish alphabet contains these special letters: **Æ**, **Ø**, and **Å**.
NOTE: The special letters found in Danish can also be found in some of the other Northern Germanic languages:
- Norwegian uses Æ, Ø, and Å.
- Faroese uses Æ and Ø but not Å.
- Icelandic only uses Æ.
- Swedish only uses Å. In addition, Swedish uses Ä and Ö, which are not found in Danish.
text_zh: **丹麥語**是一種北日耳曼語支的語言，與瑞典語和挪威語有很近的親緣關係。丹麥語字母包含這些特殊字母：**Æ**、**Ø** 和 **Å**。
注意：丹麥語中的特殊字母也可以在其他一些北日耳曼語支語言中找到：
- 挪威語使用 Æ、Ø 和 Å。
- 法羅語使用 Æ 和 Ø，但不使用 Å。
- 冰島語只使用 Æ。
- 瑞典語只使用 Å。此外，瑞典語還使用 Æ 和 Ø 中所沒有的 Ä 和 Ö。

text: Street name signs in Santo Domingo often contain the letters **“ADN”**, a reference to the Distrito Nacional, which the city is located in.
text_zh: 聖多明哥的路名標牌通常包含字母 **“ADN”**，這是該市所在國家特區（Distrito Nacional）的縮寫。

text: Taxis in Ecuador are very common, and the **first letter** on each taxi can be used to determine the province you are in. The first letter of the taxi and the first letter of the province name are often the same.

NOTE: This letter will also appear as the first letter on ordinary licence plates respectively in each region. Beware that the letter P, as the letter for Pichincha (the region containing Quito), shows up occasionally in several regions.
text_zh: 厄瓜多常看到計程車，每輛計程車上的**第一個字母**可用來判斷你所在的省份。計程車的第一個字母通常與省份名稱的第一個字母相同。
注意：這個字母也會分別出現在各個地區一般車牌的第一個字母。請注意，作為皮欽查省（包含基多的省份）代號的字母 P，偶爾也會出現在好幾個地區。

text: The official language in Egypt is **Arabic**. You can occasionally see it on signs in several of the trekkers. Its script can be identified by its lines and dots.
text_zh: 埃及的官方語言是**阿拉伯語**。你偶爾可以在幾個徒步拍攝點的標誌上看到它。其文字可以透過線條和點來辨識。

text: The monastery complex of Saint Mina consists of several large, palace-like buildings in a somewhat modern, Arabic style. Most of the buildings have several **spires** crowned with **Christian crosses**.
text_zh: 聖米納修道院建築群由幾棟大型、宮殿式的建築組成，帶有某種現代的阿拉伯風格。大多數建築都有好幾個頂部飾有**基督教十字架**的**尖頂**。

text: **Estonian** belongs to the Finnic languages, a branch of the Uralic language family. It is closely related to Finnish.
Within the Baltic languages, the following letters are unique to Estonian:
- Vowels with umlauts (two dots): Ä Ö Ü.
- Õ with a tilde.
NOTE: Latvian and Lithuanian are both Indo-European languages that are not related to Estonian, and therefore look very different.
text_zh: **愛沙尼亞語**屬於芬蘭語支，是烏拉爾語系的一個分支。它與芬蘭語密切相關。
在波羅的海諸語言中，下列字母是愛沙尼亞語特有的：
- 帶分音符（兩點）的母音：Ä Ö Ü。
- 帶波浪符的 Õ。
注意：拉脫維亞語和立陶宛語都是印歐語系語言，與愛沙尼亞語無關，因此看起來非常不同。

text: Estonia has a large Russian minority. In most of Ida-Viru County, they form a majority. As a result, you will sometimes see bilingual signs with **Russian Cyrillic** and Estonian in the region in and around Narva.
Note that the majority of signs will still be in Estonian. You may occasionally see Cyrillic in other places.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞有龐大的俄羅斯少數族群。在伊達-維魯縣（Ida-Viru County）的大部分地區，他們佔了多數。因此，納爾瓦（Narva）及其周邊地區有時會看到帶有**俄羅斯西里爾字母**與愛沙尼亞語的雙語標誌。
請注意，多數標誌仍會是愛沙尼亞語。你偶爾可能會在其他地方看到西里爾字母。

text: Roads starting with the letters **“MR”** are exclusive to Eswatini.
text_zh: 以字首 **“MR”** 開頭的道路是史瓦帝尼所獨有的。

text: The Faroese language is most closely related to Icelandic, with the special letters Á, Ð, Í, Ó, Ú, Ý, Æ and Ø. It differs from Icelandic by using the letter **Ø**, while Icelandic uses É and Þ.
text_zh: 法羅語與冰島語關係最為密切，擁有特殊字母 Á、Ð、Í、Ó、Ú、Ý、Æ 和 Ø。它與冰島語的不同之處在於使用字母 **Ø**，而冰島語則使用 É 和 Þ。

text: The **Finnish language** is not related to most other European languages, so it has a very unique look. It has a lot of long words and double vowels. The Finnish alphabet includes the letters **ä** and **ö**.
NOTE: Estonian is closely related to Finnish, so it can look similar. Estonian uses the letters õ and ü, which are not used in Finnish.
text_zh: **芬蘭語**與大多數其他歐洲語言無關，因此外觀非常獨特。它有很多長單字和雙母音。芬蘭字母包含 **ä** 和 **ö**。
注意：愛沙尼亞語與芬蘭語高度相關，因此看起來可能很相似。愛沙尼亞語使用的是 õ 和 ü，這在芬蘭語中是不會出現的。

text: The **Swedish language** is common in some coastal areas in the south and the west. In these areas, bilingual Swedish or Finnish texts are common. If you see Swedish language in a Finnish setting, do not guess inland.
text_zh: **瑞典語**在南部和西部的某些沿海地區很常見。在這些地區，雙語的瑞典語或芬蘭語文字很常見。如果你在芬蘭的場景中看到瑞典語，請不要猜內陸。

text: The [**Sámi languages**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A1mi_languages) are spoken in the far north of Finland. In this region, you can sometimes find bilingual signs with place names in both Finnish and Sámi. Unlike Finnish, its alphabet uses the letter **c**.
text_zh: [**薩米語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A1mi_languages)通行於芬蘭的最北部。在該地區，有時可以找到同時標有芬蘭語和薩米語地名的雙語標誌。與芬蘭語不同的是，它的字母表使用了字母 **c**。

text: Åland is **monolingually Swedish**. If you see only Swedish, and no Finnish language, but you suspect that you are in Finland, consider the Åland Islands.
text_zh: 奧蘭是**單一語言的瑞典語區**。如果你只看到瑞典語而沒有芬蘭語，但你懷疑自己身在芬蘭，請考慮奧蘭群島。

text: Lahti uses these street signs with a **black border** and all capital letters.

NOTE: You can rarely find similar signs in other cities, but Lahti almost exclusively uses this design. Notably, Kuopio can use these [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/wjdzkPYj7ba2NRGN7), which use a thicker, more compact font.
text_zh: 拉赫蒂使用這些帶有**黑色邊框**且全是大寫字母的路牌。
注意：你很少能在其他城市找到類似的標誌，但拉赫蒂幾乎完全使用這種設計。值得注意的是，庫奧皮奧可以使用這些[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/wjdzkPYj7ba2NRGN7)，它們使用的是更粗、更緊湊的字體。

text: The official language of Germany is **German**. The German language uses the special letters Ä, Ö, Ü and ß.

NOTE: The other majority German-speaking countries with coverage are Switzerland, Austria and Liechtenstein. In addition, German is spoken in [East Belgium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German-speaking_Community_of_Belgium) and the Italian province of [South Tyrol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Tyrol).
text_zh: 德國的官方語言是**德語**。德語使用特殊字母 Ä、Ö、Ü 和 ß。
NOTE: 有街景的其他德語主要國家為瑞士、奧地利與列支敦斯登。此外，[比利時東部](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German-speaking_Community_of_Belgium)與義大利的[南提洛](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Tyrol)省也講德語。

text: - [Berlin](https://goo.gl/maps/byoGqSgok1uhmjCy6) uses white signs with a grey border, and a separate section for numbers under the street name. Also note how the letter ß looks.
- [Munich](https://goo.gl/maps/RMshmDUSNucokmWN9) has blue street signs with a white decorative border that does not touch the corners. Also note the unique font.
- [Stuttgart](https://goo.gl/maps/fPFeuNukTiRTWoki7) uses **black** signs without a border.
- [Düsseldorf](https://goo.gl/maps/L9kbaYYwzV2iFE9n9) has **black** signs with a white border, similar to Munich. The signs have a **metallic frame.**
- [Dortmund](https://goo.gl/maps/3PhsxrNkq7oduns59) uses blue signs with a white border and a grey frame. The signs also have a separate section for numbers under the street name.
- [Essen](https://goo.gl/maps/wXngUHVBa2eS9CH2A) has blue signs with a very **thick** metallic frame.
- [Dresden](https://goo.gl/maps/S83P48x1grRfYR8H8) has blue signs with a unique font.
- [Hanover](https://goo.gl/maps/4oWah3dfDGep5sR6A) uses white signs with a **wider** than usual gap between the sign and metallic frame.
- [Nuremberg](https://goo.gl/maps/fUp3W4uEMsbFGtYH6) has blue signs with a unique font. The signs also have a grey frame with a small gap between it and the sign.
- [Wuppertal](https://goo.gl/maps/SUe7ExCD7S7SJDye7) uses white signs with a unique font and a white painted frame with a small gap between it and the sign.
- [Mainz](https://goo.gl/maps/bj8Mt4jAxn9duXodA) has a mix of blue signs, and this unique **red** variant.
- [Frankfurt ](https://goo.gl/maps/FDzr8ZLrSehrSAoC8)uses blue street signs with a metallic border around the sign, as well as the separate section for numbers under the street name.
NOTE: More rarely, some smaller towns can use similar signs to those in this graphic.
text_zh: - [柏林](https://goo.gl/maps/byoGqSgok1uhmjCy6)使用帶有灰色邊框的白色標誌，街道名稱下方有一個獨立區域來放置數字。同時注意字母 ß 的外觀。
- [慕尼黑](https://goo.gl/maps/RMshmDUSNucokmWN9)擁有藍色街道標誌，配有白色裝飾邊框，且邊框不觸及角落。同時注意其獨特的字型。
- [斯圖加特](https://goo.gl/maps/fPFeuNukTiRTWoki7)使用無邊框的**黑色**標誌。
- [杜塞道夫](https://goo.gl/maps/L9kbaYYwzV2iFE9n9)擁有帶有白色邊框的**黑色**標誌，類似於慕尼黑。這些標誌具有**金屬框。**
- [多特蒙德](https://goo.gl/maps/3PhsxrNkq7oduns59)使用帶有白色邊框和灰色框的藍色標誌。標誌在街道名稱下方也有一個獨立區域來放置數字。
- [埃森](https://goo.gl/maps/wXngUHVBa2eS9CH2A)擁有帶有非常**厚**金屬框的藍色標誌。
- [德勒斯登](https://goo.gl/maps/S83P48x1grRfYR8H8)擁有使用獨特字型的藍色標誌。
- [漢諾威](https://goo.gl/maps/4oWah3dfDGep5sR6A)使用白色標誌，標誌與金屬框之間的間距比平常**更寬**。
- [紐倫堡](https://goo.gl/maps/fUp3W4uEMsbFGtYH6)擁有使用獨特字型的藍色標誌。這些標誌還具有灰色框，且框與標誌之間有一小段間距。
- [伍珀塔爾](https://goo.gl/maps/SUe7ExCD7S7SJDye7)使用帶有獨特字型的白色標誌，以及白色塗漆框，框與標誌之間有一小段間距。
- [梅因斯](https://goo.gl/maps/bj8Mt4jAxn9duXodA)混合使用了藍色標誌以及這種獨特的**紅色**變體。
- [法蘭克福](https://goo.gl/maps/FDzr8ZLrSehrSAoC8)使用藍色街道標誌，標誌周圍有金屬邊框，且街道名稱下方有放置數字的獨立區域。
NOTE: 更罕見的是，某些較小的城鎮可能會使用與此圖形相似的標誌。

text: [Sorbian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sorbian_languages), a **Slavic** language, is spoken near the Polish and Czech border. You can find it on a variety of signs in these regions.
text_zh: [索布語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sorbian_languages)是一種**斯拉夫**語言，通行於波蘭和捷克邊境附近。你可以在這些地區的各種標誌上找到它。

text: The main language used in Gibraltar is **English**. This can be especially helpful if you see English on official signs in a Mediterranean setting.
NOTE: Note that English is also one of the main languages of Malta, which also has a Mediterranean landscape and vibe.
text_zh: 直布羅陀使用的主要語言是**英語**。如果你在地中海風情的環境中看到英文，這會特別有幫助。
註：請注意，英語也是馬爾他（Malta）的主要語言之一，馬爾他同樣擁有地中海景觀和氛圍。

text: The Greek language features a **unique alphabet** not used in any other language. It shares similarities with both the Latin and [Cyrillic](/images/greece/greece_cyrillic.png) alphabets, however the lower case letters generally have softer shapes than the Cyrillic letters.
NOTE: Cyprus also uses the Greek alphabet.
text_zh: 希臘語具有一個在其他任何語言中都沒有使用的**獨特字母表**。它與拉丁字母和[斯拉夫字母](/images/greece/greece_cyrillic.png)都有相似之處，然而小寫字母通常比斯拉夫字母具有更柔和的形狀。
註：賽普勒斯也使用希臘字母。

text: Greek kilometre markers are blue, having “km” written on the left in both the **Latin and Greek** alphabets.
text_zh: 希臘的公里標示牌是藍色的，左側以**拉丁字母和希臘字母**兩種文字寫著「km」。

text: **East Asian languages** such as Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and even Russian are common to see in Guam.
NOTE: This is also the case in Northern Mariana Islands.
text_zh: 在關島很常看到日文、中文、韓文甚至是俄文等**東亞語言**。
注意：北馬利安納群島也是如此。

text: Hawaii is the only state to use its own language, though English is still predominantly used. Most **place names** are in Hawaiian, so you can spot it on street signs, and other road markers.
- Hawaiian is a vowel-oriented language that only uses eight consonants: H, K, L, M, N, P, W, and (ʻ), called an [ʻOkina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CA%BBOkina).
- Every Hawaiian word ends in one of 5 vowels: A, E, I, O, or U.
- Each vowel can also have a [macron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macron_(diacritic)) over it: Ā, Ē, Ī, Ō, and Ū.
These vowels are often combined to make [Diphthongs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diphthong). I.e. UI, AI, AE, etc...
text_zh: 夏威夷是唯一使用自身語言的州，不過英語仍然佔壓倒性多數的使用率。大多數**地名**都是夏威夷語，因此你可以在路標和其他道路標誌上發現它。
- 夏威夷語是一種以母音為主的語言，只使用八個子音：H、K、L、M、N、P、W 和 (ʻ)，稱為 [ʻOkina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CA%BBOkina)。
- 每個夏威夷單字都以 A、E、I、O 或 U 這 5 個母音之一結尾。
- 每個母音上方也可以加上[長音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macron_(diacritic))：Ā、Ē、Ī、Ō 和 Ū。
這些母音經常組合在一起形成[雙母音](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diphthong)。例如 UI、AI、AE 等...

text: Hong Kong has two official languages: **English and Chinese** (legally, no variety is specified, but residents primarily speak Cantonese).
Bilingual signs are common, with English next to traditional Chinese characters.
text_zh: 香港有兩種官方語言：**英文與中文**（法律上未指定具體語種，但居民主要說粵語）。
雙語標誌很常見，英文與繁體中文並列。

text: The **Hungarian language** has a unique look, with a very large number of [acute accents](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acute_accent), [umlauts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umlaut_(diacritic)) over o’s, and long words. The letters "Ő" and "Ű", with double acute accents, are unique to the language.
NOTE: Hungarian is also spoken in some parts of neighbouring countries: notably there are large Hungarian-speaking communities in central Romania and southern Slovakia.
text_zh: **匈牙利語**具有獨特的外觀，擁有大量的[尖音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acute_accent)、o字母上的[分音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umlaut_(diacritic))以及長單詞。帶有雙尖音符的字母「Ő」和「Ű」是該語言所特有的。
注意：鄰國的部分地區也講匈牙利語：特別是在羅馬尼亞中部和斯洛伐克南部，有大型的匈牙利語社群。

text: Apart from European highways, there are two types of numbered roads in Hungary; roads marked with **green signs**, and highways beginning with the letter ‘**M**’, marked with **blue signs**. These road numbers are contained within a small shield shape on the sign.
text_zh: 除了歐洲高速公路外，匈牙利還有兩種編號道路；標有**綠色標誌**的道路，以及以字母「**M**」開頭、標有**藍色標誌**的高速公路。這些道路編號包含在標誌上的一個小型盾形圖案中。

text: The Icelandic language contains a couple of **unique letters**. These are some of the most recognizable ones: ð þ and æ. Vowels can have the following accents: á é í ó ö ú ý. The uppercase version of ð is Ð.
NOTE: ð is also found in the Faroese language. æ is found in Danish, Norwegian and Faroese.
text_zh: 冰島語包含幾個**獨特的字母**。以下是其中幾個最容易辨識的：ð、þ 和 æ。母音可以有以下附加符號：á、é、í、ó、ö、ú、ý。ð 的大寫形式是 Ð。
注意：ð 也見於法羅語。æ 則見於丹麥語、挪威語和法羅語。

text: **English** is also an official language in India and can be seen on a lot of signage.
text_zh: **英語**也是印度的官方語言，可以在許多招牌上看到。

text: **Hindi** is the most common language in India and can be found in many central and northern regions. It uses the [Devanagari script](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devanagari), which can be recognised by the line going through the top of each word and the straight vertical lines found in the majority of all letters.
text_zh: **印地語**是印度最常見的語言，可在許多中部和北部地區找到。它使用[天城文](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Devanagari)，其特徵為每個文字上方貫穿一條橫線，且絕大多數字母都有垂直的直線。

text: **Marathi**, found in Maharashtra, also uses the Devanagari script, however it sometimes uses the letter **ळ** which is not found in Hindi.
text_zh: 在馬哈拉施特拉邦找到的**馬拉地語**也使用天城文，但它有時會使用印地語中沒有的字母 **ळ**。

text: **Punjabi** can be found in Punjab in northwestern India. While the script looks somewhat similar to Hindi, it can generally be differentiated by the softer shape of the letters and the horizontal bar being broken over certain letters. It also has some distinctly different features, such as the letters **ਨ**, **ਲ** and** ਅ **as well as a [diacritic](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E0%A9%81) in the shape of a soft curve beneath a letter.
text_zh: 可在印度西北部的旁遮普邦找到**旁遮普語**。雖然文字看起來有點像印地語，但通常可以透過較柔和的字母形狀以及在某些字母上方斷開的橫條來區分。它也有一些明顯不同的特徵，例如字母 **ਨ**、**ਲ** 和 **ਅ**，以及字母下方呈柔軟曲線形狀的[附加符號](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E0%A9%81)。

text: **Gujarati**, found in Gujarat, has a script with several similarities to the Hindi script, however it notably lacks the horizontal line at the top of every word.
text_zh: 在古吉拉特邦找到的**古吉拉特語**，其文字與印地語有幾個相似之處，但它顯著缺少了每個文字頂部的橫線。

text: **Bengali** is found in northeastern India and has a similar look to Devanagari (Hindi), however it can usually be recognised by the many letters featuring left-facing triangular shapes.
NOTE: This is also the language found in Bangladesh.
text_zh: **孟加拉語**分佈在印度東北部，外觀與天城文（印地語）相似，但通常可以透過許多帶有朝左三角形形狀的字母來辨認。
注意：這也是在孟加拉找到的語言。

text: **Assamese**, mainly found in Assam, also uses the Bengali script, with the addition of some characters, most notably **ৰ** and **ৱ**.
text_zh: 主要在阿薩姆邦找到的**阿薩姆語**也使用孟加拉語文字，並增加了幾個字元，最明顯的是 **ৰ** 和 **ৱ**。

text: **Kannada** is found in Karnataka and has a script with a lot of smooth curves and small circles. It is very similar to the Telugu script, with Telugu having one additional feature described in the next tip. Many characters also feature a distinct squiggly tail in the top right corner, which is less common in Telugu.
text_zh: **卡納達語**分佈在卡納塔克邦，其文字有許多平滑的曲線和小圓圈。它與泰 Telugu 語非常相似，而 Telugu 語多了一個下一個提示中描述的特徵。許多字元在右上角也有一個明顯的捲曲尾巴，這在 Telugu 語中較少見。

text: **Telugu**, found in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, has a script very similar to Kannada, but you’ll often see diacritics resembling checkmarks at the top of letters.
text_zh: 分佈在特倫 Telangana 邦和安 Andhra Pradesh 邦的 **Telugu 語**，其文字與卡納達語非常相似，但你經常會看到字母頂部有類似打勾記號的附加符號。

text: The **Tamil** script is found in Tamil Nadu and has a distinct combination of curves, straight lines and **90° angles**. Some letters also have diacritics shaped like dots.
NOTE: Tamil is also commonly found in Sri Lanka.
text_zh: **泰 Tamil 語**文字分佈在 Tamil Nadu 邦，具有曲線、直線和 **90度角**的獨特組合。有些字母也有像點一樣形狀的附加符號。
注意：Tamil 語在斯里蘭卡也很常見。

text: The **Oriya** script is found in Odisha and has a curvy look, with many letters having wide semi-circles covering the top. Many letters have a distinct diacritic in the shape of a wide curve above the top of the letter. A useful mnemonic is that the shape of the characters resembles a [skull emoji](/images/india/skullemoji.png?).
text_zh: **奧里亞語**分佈在奧里薩邦，外觀呈曲線狀，許多字母都有覆蓋頂部的寬半圓。許多字母在字母頂部上方有一個寬曲線形狀的獨特附加符號。一個實用的記憶法是字元的形狀類似[骷髏表情符號](/images/india/skullemoji.png?)。

text: The **Malayalam** script can be found in Kerala and mostly consists of somewhat simple-looking curvy letters, often containing upside-down **U-shapes**.
text_zh: **馬 Malayalam 語**分佈在 Kerala 邦，主要由看起來有點簡單的曲線字母組成，通常包含倒置的 **U 型**。

text: **Manipuri**, also called Meitei, is the official language of Manipur. It is written using the Meitei script, which can be recognised by its many vertical lines and right angles.
text_zh: **曼 Manipur 語**（也稱為 Meitei 語）是 Manipur 邦的官方語言。它是使用 Meitei 文字書寫的，其特徵是許多垂直線和直角。

text: **Mizo**, found in Mizoram,** **is the language most commonly found on the Indian coverage other than English, which uses the **Latin script**.
text_zh: 分佈在 Mizoram 邦的**米左語**，** **除了英語之外，是印度街景中最常看到的語言，它使用**拉丁字母**。

text: Irish signage is often bilingual, with English in a regular font, and **Irish in italics**. Place names, regular words and phrases are all translated.
Irish language is somewhat less common on non-official signage.
text_zh: 愛爾蘭的標誌通常是雙語的，英文使用一般字體，**愛爾蘭語使用斜體**。地名、一般單字和片語都會被翻譯。
愛爾蘭語在非官方標誌上比較少見。

text: This generic lamp design with a **blue base** and a **small blue sticker** can be found on most of the island, except for around Douglas, and some parts northeast and south. In addition, the top 2 letters can be used to narrow your location down to 1 of the 21 [parishes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_government_in_the_Isle_of_Man#/media/File:IsleOfMan_LocAuths_and_Sheadings2020.svg).
text_zh: 這種帶有**藍色底座**和**小型藍色貼紙**的通用燈具設計幾乎遍布全島，除了道格拉斯（Douglas）周邊以及東北部和南部的一些地區之外。此外，頂部的 2 個字母可以用來將你的位置縮小到 21 個[教區](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_government_in_the_Isle_of_Man#/media/File:IsleOfMan_LocAuths_and_Sheadings2020.svg)之一。

text: A **small yellow sticker** is present on lamps in southern Onchan. The 2 letters are the initials of the road name. E.g. ‘SD’ for Sunningdale Drive.
text_zh: 奧恩坎（Onchan）南部的燈桿上貼有一張**小型黃色貼紙**。這兩個字母是路名的縮寫。例如：Sunningdale Drive 的「SD」。

text: You will typically find two languages; **Hebrew**, which is practically only found in Israel and the West Bank, and Arabic, which is particularly common in the West Bank.
text_zh: 你通常會找到兩種語言：**希伯來語**（幾乎只在以色列和約旦河西岸找到）以及阿拉伯語（在約旦河西岸特別常見）。

text: Blue house numbers with the number written with [Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals) in the top left and with [Eastern Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals) in the bottom right, with a thin **diagonal line** between them, can be found in Bethlehem. [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9) will generally have the same format.
text_zh: 藍色門牌號碼，左上角用[阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals)書寫，右下角用[東阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals)書寫，兩者之間有一條細**斜線**，可以在伯利恆找到。[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9)通常也會採用相同的格式。

text: **Cyrillic **can be found on signs in the cities of Wakkanai and Nemuro, in northern Hokkaido.
text_zh: 北海道北部的稚內市與根室市，招牌上找得到**西里爾字母**。

text: Jersey licence plates follow the British model, having a long **white front** and **yellow rear** plate. In addition, you will notice the island’s red coat of arms on the left, as well as the letter ‘J’ at the beginning of all codes in unblurred plates.
NOTE: In contrast to the British mainland, Jersey was never a member of the European Union. This means that local plates do not have a blue strip.
text_zh: 澤西島車牌遵循英國模式，具有長條形的**白色前車牌**和**黃色後車牌**。此外，你會注意到左側有該島的紅色徽章，且在清晰未模糊的車牌上，所有代碼開頭都有一個「J」字。
註：與英國本土不同，澤西島從未加入歐盟。這意味著當地車牌沒有藍色邊條。

text: Due to its proximity to France, the vast majority of street and locality names contain **French **words. The island’s traditional language, known as [Jèrriais](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A8rriais), is closely related to French and appears on some [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/gfXPVEU3CehwnLD79).
text_zh: 由於鄰近法國，絕大多數的街道和地名都包含**法文**單字。該島的傳統語言被稱為[澤西語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A8rriais)，與法語密切相關，並出現在一些[路標](https://goo.gl/maps/gfXPVEU3CehwnLD79)上。

text: The official language used in Jordan is **Arabic** and can be identified by its lines and dots.
NOTE: Unlike the UAE, Jordan does not have English writing on most commercial signs. This can be helpful to distinguish the two countries.
text_zh: 約旦使用的官方語言是**阿拉伯語**，可以透過其線條和點來辨識。
註：與阿拉伯聯合大公國不同，約旦的大多數商業標誌上沒有英文書寫。這有助於區分這兩個國家。

text: Kazakhstan uses both Cyrillic and Latin alphabets.
Though sometimes, Russian is used monolingually.
- The following letters are found in the Kazakh but not Russian alphabet: Ә (Ä), Ғ (Ǵ), Қ (Q), Ң (Ń), Ө (Ö), Ұ (W), Ү (Ü), Һ (H), І (I).
- Kazakh is related to Turkish, so the Latin text can appear similar.
text_zh: 哈薩克使用斯拉夫字母（Cyrillic）與拉丁字母（Latin alphabets）。
不過有時會單獨使用俄語。
- 以下字母存在於哈薩克語但不存在於俄語字母中：Ә (Ä), Ғ (Ǵ), Қ (Q), Ң (Ń), Ө (Ö), Ұ (W), Ү (Ü), Һ (H), І (I)。
- 哈薩克語和土耳其語有親屬關係，因此拉丁字母文本看起來可能很相似。

text: You can occasionally spot licence plate codes on the back of [trucks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tKZW4WNWfm8LC6Bf8) and [buses](https://goo.gl/maps/ShsB6GNeCf3cp4gB6). The codes themselves follow an alphabetical order, with smaller numbers corresponding to regions that start with earlier letters. Note that cars do travel, and as such not all codes are reliable. Buses and smaller utility vehicles are the most reliable.
text_zh: 你偶爾可以在[卡車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tKZW4WNWfm8LC6Bf8)和[公車](https://goo.gl/maps/ShsB6GNeCf3cp4gB6)背面發現車牌代碼。這些代碼本身遵循字母順序，較小的數字對應到字母開頭較早的地區。請注意，車輛是會移動的，因此並非所有代碼都可靠。公車和小型商用車最為可靠。

text: While rarely possible, being able to read the letters under a QR code on a street sign will give you the region.
text_zh: 雖然極少數情況下可行，但如果能讀懂路牌上 QR 碼下方的字母，就能知道所在的地區。

text: The Kyrgyz script is similar to Russian. However, the Cyrillic script used for Kyrgyz includes additional characters not found in Russian Cyrillic, such as:
- Ө
- Ү
- Ң
text_zh: 吉爾吉斯文使用的文字與俄文相似。不過吉爾吉斯文的西里爾字母多了幾個俄文西里爾字母沒有的字元，例如：
- Ө
- Ү
- Ң

text: **Lao script** is compact and curvy, with some diacritics on top and below characters.
NOTE: It is very similar to Thai script, but (in most fonts) Lao script has fewer straight lines.
text_zh: **寮國文字**緊湊而曲線優美，字元上方和下方有一些附加符號。
註記：它與泰國文字非常相似，但（在大多數字型中）寮國文字的直線較少。

text: **Stop signs** feature the Lao script. Sometimes, the sign features the word ‘stop’ in Latin script below the Lao script.
NOTE: In Laos, stop signs only have **2 characters,** compared to 3 in Thailand.
text_zh: **停止標誌**具有寮國文字。有時，標誌在寮國文字下方會標有拉丁字母的「stop」一詞。
註記：在寮國，停止標誌只有**2個字元，**相較之下泰國有3個。

text: **Latvian** belongs to the Baltic languages. The other major member of this branch is Lithuanian, to which it is closely related.
Within the Baltic languages, the following letters are unique to Latvian:
- Vowels with a macron (horizontal stripe): Ā Ē Ī.
- Consonants with a small hook: Ģ Ķ Ļ Ņ.
NOTE: Estonian is not a member of the Baltic languages(despite the name), and therefore looks significantly different.
text_zh: **拉脫維亞語**屬於波羅的海語族。這個分支的另一個主要成員是立陶宛語，與之密切相關。
在波羅的海語族中，下列字母是拉脫維亞語專有的：
- 帶長音符（水平橫線）的母音：Ā Ē Ī。
- 帶小勾的子音：Ģ Ķ Ļ Ņ。
注意：愛沙尼亞語不屬於波羅的海語族（儘管名字像），因此看起來有很大的差異。

text: The official language of Lebanon is **Arabic**, however [English](https://goo.gl/maps/wAohfpzv2g5ayJyy7) and [French](https://goo.gl/maps/JJ7RJ4cZ246BJksc9) are also common to see.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩的官方語言是**阿拉伯語**，不過[英語](https://goo.gl/maps/wAohfpzv2g5ayJyy7)和[法語](https://goo.gl/maps/JJ7RJ4cZ246BJksc9)也很常見。

text: Black signs with a white border and embossed letters can be found in Schaan.
text_zh: 帶有白色邊框和浮雕字體的黑色標誌可以在沙恩找到。

text: **Lithuanian** belongs to the Baltic languages. The other major member of this branch is Latvian, to which it is closely related.
Within the Baltic languages, the following letters are unique to Lithuanian:
- Vowels with small hooks: Ą Ę Į Ų.
- Ė with a single dot.
- Y (also in Estonian, but only in loan words).
NOTE: Estonian is not a member of the Baltic languages (despite its name), and therefore looks significantly different.
text_zh: **立陶宛語**屬於波羅的海語族。這個語族另一個主要的成員是拉脫維亞語，兩者關係十分密切。
在波羅的海語族中，以下字母是立陶宛語獨有的：
- 帶小鉤的母音：Ą Ę Į Ų。
- 帶一個點的 Ė。
- Y（愛沙尼亞語也有，但僅限於外來語）。
注意：愛沙尼亞語不屬於波羅的海語族（儘管名字像），因此看起來有很大的差異。

text: Rarely, you can see bilingual signs with **Polish language** in a small area southeast of Lithuania.
Note that this is by no means very common, but it can help with getting very close guesses if you do see bilingual Polish-Lithuanian signs in an otherwise obvious Lithuanian setting.
text_zh: 在立陶宛東南部的極小區域內，偶爾可以看到帶有**波蘭語**的雙語標誌。
請注意，這絕對不是很常見，但如果你在一個明顯是立陶宛的環境中看到波蘭語與立陶宛語的雙語標誌，它能幫助你做出非常精準的猜測。

text: Luxembourg is a highly **multilingual country**. It has three administrative languages: Luxembourgish, French, and German.
French is the language that is mostly used for public communication. Road signs and advertisements are usually in French.
Presence of German on signs is less common compared to French, but certainly not non-existent.
text_zh: 盧森堡是一個高度**多語言的國家**。它有三種官方語言：盧森堡語、法語和德語。
法語是用於公共交流最主要的語言。道路標誌和廣告通常都是法語。
與法語相比，標誌上出現德語的情況較少，但也並非完全沒有。

text: Due to Macau’s history as a Portuguese colony, **Portuguese language** can commonly be seen, especially on storefronts, along with Chinese.
text_zh: 由於澳門作為葡萄牙殖民地的歷史，經常可以看到**葡萄牙語**，特別是在店面招牌上，並伴隨中文。

text: A **hilly,** **rural** region of Macau can be found in the south. Roads are narrow, winding up hills with trees on both sides. A helpful clue are the lamp posts, which are commonly seen.

When this area appears in a world map, it can be confusing to newer players, as there are very few language or architecture clues available. The washed out early Generation 2 coverage can help with identifying it as being located in Macau.
text_zh: 在澳門南部可以找到一個**多山、** **鄉村風情**的地區。道路狹窄，蜿蜒上山，兩側都是樹木。一個有用的線索是經常可以看到的燈柱。
當這個地區出現在世界地圖上時，對於新玩家來說可能會感到困惑，因為可用的語言或建築線索非常少。早期褪色的第 2 代覆蓋可以幫助辨識其位於澳門。

text: Madagascar has two official languages: **French** and [**Malagasy**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malagasy_language), which is written with the Latin alphabet and contains many long, multiple-syllable words.
NOTE: [English](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1GZYGSBw3AdKn7CF6) can still be found on some commercial signs.
text_zh: 馬達加斯加有兩種官方語言：**法語**與[**馬達加斯加語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malagasy_language)，它是用拉丁字母書寫，並包含許多長音、多音節的單字。
注意：在某些商業招牌上仍然可以找到[英文](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1GZYGSBw3AdKn7CF6)。

text: The **Malay language** uses the Latin script. It is very closely related to Indonesian. These two languages are practically indistinguishable for people who do not speak either.
text_zh: **馬來語** 使用拉丁字母。它與印尼語非常相近。對於不會這兩種語言的人來說，這兩種語言幾乎無法區分。

text: Each Malaysian state, excluding the three federal territories, has its own road numbering system with a **unique letter** at the start of the road number.
NOTE: Sabah also has A roads, but only the A2 and A7.
text_zh: 馬來西亞各州（不含三個聯邦直轄區）都有自己的道路編號系統，路號開頭帶有**獨特的字母**。
NOTE: 沙巴也有 A 開頭的道路，但只有 A2 和 A7。

text: **Green** street signs that form an arrow shape and have a **yellow hexagonal symbol **with the letters** JKR** on the left side are found in Sabah.
text_zh: 呈現箭頭形狀且左側有帶有 **JKR** 字樣的**黃色六角形符號**的**綠色**路名牌可以在沙巴找到。

text: **English** is the primary language of Malta.
text_zh: **英文**是馬爾他的主要語言。

text: Apart from English it is also common to see the **Maltese** language. Maltese uses the Latin script, but with unique letters, which include:
- Ċ ċ
- Ġ ġ
- Ħ ħ
- Ż ż
text_zh: 除了英文之外，看到**馬爾他語**也很常見。馬爾他語使用拉丁字母，但帶有獨特的字母，其中包括：
- Ċ ċ
- Ġ ġ
- Ħ ħ
- Ż ż

text: Similarly, Mexican **postal codes** can be seen on this map. They will commonly appear at the [bottom of street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/8bgZx7q8pjzzFSYi6), and are ordered alphabetically based on state names.
text_zh: 同樣地，墨西哥的**郵遞區號**也可以從這張地圖上看到。它們通常會出現在[路牌底部](https://goo.gl/maps/8bgZx7q8pjzzFSYi6)，並根據州名按字母順序排列。

text: Mongolia primarily uses **Cyrillic **script, though [Latin](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.912178,106.980081,3a,17.5y,297.7h,98.09t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s5Bf-6kOlFPU1X7Sd37ewaw!2e0) and [traditional Mongolian](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.0335237,111.6546939,2a,63.5y,344.76h,97.65t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3xuVpyvGy0UEgWOxX2rmTA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) script can also occasionally be seen. Mongolian Cyrillic contains the letters **Ɵ** and **Ү**,** **which do not exist in the Russian alphabet. Additionally, the use of **double vowels**,** **such as aa, ƟƟ or ЭЭ, is common in Mongolian.
NOTE: The letters **Ɵ** and **Ү **also exist in the Kyrgyz and Kazakh languages.
text_zh: 蒙古主要使用**西里爾**字母，不過偶爾也能看到[拉丁](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.912178,106.980081,3a,17.5y,297.7h,98.09t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s5Bf-6kOlFPU1X7Sd37ewaw!2e0)和[傳統蒙古](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.0335237,111.6546939,2a,63.5y,344.76h,97.65t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s3xuVpyvGy0UEgWOxX2rmTA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)字母。蒙古西里爾字母包含俄語字母中沒有的 **Ɵ** 和 **Ү** 字母。此外，蒙古語中常使用**雙元音**，例如 aa、ƟƟ 或 ЭЭ。
註：**Ɵ** 和 **Ү** 字母也存在於吉爾吉斯語和哈薩克語中。

text: Generation 4 coverage in **eastern Mongolia** uses a silver pick-up truck with a large **metal box **and shovel on the roof. The car was sponsored by Bodi Group, however camera stitching generally hides one of the letters.
text_zh: **蒙古東部**的第 4 代街景使用銀色小貨卡，車頂上有一個**大金屬箱**和圓鍬。這輛車是由 Bodi Group 贊助的，不過相機拼接通常會遮住其中一個字母。

text: The desert town of Zamiin-Uud on the border with China has unique **sailboat lamp posts **featuring a** golden flower pot** around them. Often, white signs with Mongolian folded script can be seen attached to these lamp posts.

NOTE: The other desert towns of Choir and Sainshand look similar to Zamiin-Uud and have the same Street View car but use different lamp posts. Choir can be identified by its [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.356902,108.371902,3a,110.3y,325.7h,98.24t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s6djXgVDAZ-fDj71h8NhXQA!2e0) lamp posts and Sainshand by its [white](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.893259,110.142104,3a,76.1y,92.3h,99.02t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQ5CKt2u89UjuWb7RAyy5ig!2e0) lamp posts.
text_zh: 位於中蒙邊境的沙漠城鎮扎門烏德（Zamiin-Uud）擁有獨特的**風帆燈柱**，燈柱周圍帶有**金色花盆**。通常可以看到附掛在這些燈柱上、寫有蒙古垂直蒙文的白色標牌。

注意：其他沙漠城鎮喬伊爾和賽音山達看起來與扎門烏德相似，並使用相同的 Google 車，但使用的是不同的燈柱。喬伊爾可透過其[藍色](https://www.google.com/maps/@46.356902,108.371902,3a,110.3y,325.7h,98.24t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1s6djXgVDAZ-fDj71h8NhXQA!2e0)燈柱辨識，賽音山達則透過其[白色](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.893259,110.142104,3a,76.1y,92.3h,99.02t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQ5CKt2u89UjuWb7RAyy5ig!2e0)燈柱辨識。

text: Nepal uses the **Devanagari script**, which can be recognised by the line going through the top of each word and the straight vertical lines found in the majority of all letters.

NOTE: The characters ङ and especially ङ्ग are much more common in Nepali than in Hindi/Marathi. It is also quite common to find [native Devanagari numbers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iZWe7Td5ovENJDEF7) on signage in Nepal, which is very rare in India.
text_zh: 尼泊爾使用**天城體文字**（Devanagari script），其特徵是每個文字上方都有一條貫穿的橫線，且大多數字母都有筆直的垂直線。
注意：字元 ङ、特別是 ङ्ग 在尼泊爾語中比在印地語／馬拉地語中常見得多。在尼泊爾的招牌上也常能看到[本地的天城體數字](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iZWe7Td5ovENJDEF7)，這在印度非常罕見。

text: **Dutch** is a Germanic language. It features a lot of double vowels. Typical letter clusters are ij, ieuw and oe. “IJ“ written as one capitalised letter is also unique to the language.
NOTE: Dutch is also used in the region of Flanders, which comprises the northern half of Belgium.
text_zh: **荷蘭語**是一種日耳曼語族語言。它有許多雙母音。典型的字母組合有 ij、ieuw 和 oe。「IJ」寫成一個大寫字母也是該語言獨有的。
注意：荷蘭語也用於法蘭德斯（Flanders）地區，該地區包含了比利時的北部一半。

text: Dutch **road markers** are green. Many list the road number in a small yellow or red box.
Highways have a red box and start with the letter **A**. Regional roads have a yellow box and start with the letter **N**.
