NOTE: Some of them have province-specific designs. You can learn more about this in the region-guessing section.
text_zh: 荷蘭的**道路里程標示**是綠色的。許多標示會在一個小黃框或紅框內列出道路編號。
高速公路有紅框且以字母 **A** 開頭。區域道路有黃框且以字母 **N** 開頭。
註：其中有些擁有省份專屬的設計。你可以在分區猜題部分了解更多相關資訊。

text: In the province of Friesland, the Frisian language is commonly spoken. While Dutch language is still most prevalent on signs, a lot of town entry signs will feature **bilingual town names**.
Some street names in Friesland uniquely end in -wei or -strjitte.

NOTE: Frisian has vowels with [circumflex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circumflex) diacritics (“little hats”): Â, Ê, Ô and Û. Dutch does not have these letters, except in loanwords. In addition, the Y is significantly more common compared to Dutch.
text_zh: 在弗里斯蘭省，人們普遍說弗里斯蘭語。雖然荷蘭語在招牌上仍然最為普遍，但許多城鎮入口招牌會採用**雙語城鎮名稱**。
弗里斯蘭省的一些路名獨特地以 -wei 或 -strjitte 結尾。
註：弗里斯蘭語有帶有[揚抑符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circumflex)變音符號（「小帽子」）的母音：Â、Ê、Ô 和 Û。荷蘭語沒有這些字母，借詞除外。此外，與荷蘭語相比，Y 的使用頻率顯著更高。

text: **East Asian languages** such as Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and even Russian are common to see in the Northern Mariana Islands.
NOTE: This is also the case in Guam.
text_zh: 在北馬利安納群島常見到**東亞語言**，例如日文、中文、韓文，甚至是俄文。
注意：關島也是如此。

text: On smaller roads, it is common to see these blue signs with a **large white M**.

NOTE: Similar signs can be found in [Sweden](https://goo.gl/maps/DqYAkha51nY72ao49), however the font is distinctly different. The middle point of the M does not extend to the bottom of the letter. There are no similar signs in Finland.
text_zh: 在較小的道路上，常見到這些帶有**大型白色 M** 的藍色標誌。
注意：類似的標誌可以在[瑞典](https://goo.gl/maps/DqYAkha51nY72ao49)找到，但字體明顯不同。M 的中點不會延伸到字母底部。芬蘭沒有類似的標誌。

text: Small **white square signs**, displaying the road number on top, and the distance to the closest town, are common to see along medium sized roads.

The road number will be preceded either by an R or an [F](https://www.google.se/maps/@62.2252395,6.269883,3a,15y,195.25h,79.98t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sz50wFAvEtsVFmAutPi8UBQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). F roads show up as Fv on the map and are generally difficult to locate, while R roads lack any letters on the map and are generally more findable.
text_zh: 中型道路沿線常見到小型**白色正方形標誌**，上方顯示道路編號，下方顯示到最近城鎮的距離。
道路編號前面會加上 R 或 [F](https://www.google.se/maps/@62.2252395,6.269883,3a,15y,195.25h,79.98t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sz50wFAvEtsVFmAutPi8UBQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。F 道路在地圖上顯示為 Fv，通常較難定位，而 R 道路在地圖上沒有任何字母，通常更容易找到。

text: Bilingual signs with **Sámi** can be found in several northern areas in Norway. While the Sámi languages are very different from Norwegian, the best way to recognize them are the letters Á, Đ and the use of several vowels in a row, something which is uncommon in Norwegian.
Note that not all signs in these areas will be bilingual.
text_zh: 在挪威的多個北部地區可以找到帶有**薩米語**（Sámi）的雙語標誌。雖然薩米語與挪威語非常不同，但辨識它們的最佳方式是字母 Á、Đ 以及連續使用多個母音，這在挪威語中是不常見的。
請注意，這些地區並非所有標誌都是雙語的。

text: The official language in Oman is **Arabic**.
NOTE: Due to high tourism, signs in Oman often have English writing alongside Arabic. The same also applies to the UAE.
text_zh: 阿曼的官方語言是**阿拉伯文**。
注意：由於觀光業發達，阿曼的標誌上經常有英文與阿拉伯文並列。阿拉伯聯合大公國也是如此。

text: Directional signs are** blue with white text** and are usually in **Arabic and English**.
NOTE: The UAE and Qatar use similar signs.
text_zh: 方向指示牌為**藍底白字**，通常使用**阿拉伯文與英文**。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國與卡達使用類似的標誌。

text: Just west of ميتان, only labelled in Arabic on Google Maps, literally translating to methane, there is a stretch of road, which has a uniquely light-coloured pavement. To the north, you can see [sand dunes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHoRRV2ud19p4Jbz9).
text_zh: 就在米坦（ميتان，在 Google 地圖上僅有阿拉伯文標示，直譯為甲烷）的正西方，有一段路面顏色獨特較淺的道路。往北看可以看到[沙丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHoRRV2ud19p4Jbz9)。

text: While many languages are spoken in Pakistan, Urdu is considered the National language and most commonly found on signage. It is written in the [Urdu alphabet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urdu_alphabet), which is closely related to the Arabic alphabet and may appear almost indistinguishable, however Urdu often uses softer and curvier fonts.
Notably, [English](https://goo.gl/maps/Arq4sy3Xs784b4h18) is also an official language in Pakistan and is fairly common on signage.
text_zh: 雖然巴基斯坦使用許多語言，但烏都語被視為國語，最常出現在招牌上。它是用[烏都字母](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urdu_alphabet)書寫，與阿拉伯字母密切相關，可能看起來幾乎無法區分，不過烏都語通常使用更柔和、更彎曲的字型。
值得注意的是，[英文](https://goo.gl/maps/Arq4sy3Xs784b4h18)也是巴基斯坦的官方語言，在招牌上相當常見。

text: Although Filipino is the official language of the Philippines, **English** is extremely common to find on signs. It is the only major Southeast Asian country where you’re likely to come across English.
text_zh: 雖然菲律賓語是菲律賓的官方語言，但標誌上出現 **英文** 的情況非常普遍。這是你可能會遇到英文的主要東南亞國家中唯一的一個。

text: **Polish** is a Slavic language. In contrast to other slavic languages, the Polish alphabet includes:
- Ł with a stroke through it (unique to Polish)
- Ą and Ę with a small hook (also found in Lithuanian)
- Ć, Ń, Ó, Ś, Ź with an acute accent. Of these, Ń is unique to Polish. In addition, the only other language with Ś and Ź is Montenegrin.
- Ż with a small dot (unique to Polish)

Polish is very consonant-heavy, with lots of consonant clusters. Polish does not use V. Instead, it uses W a lot, the only Slavic language to do so. Other unusually common consonants are the Z, K, and C.
text_zh: **波蘭語**是一種斯拉夫語。與其他斯拉夫語相比，波蘭語字母包含：
- 帶有一斜杠的 Ł（波蘭語獨有）
- 帶有小勾的 Ą 和 Ę（立陶宛語中也能找到）
- 帶有尖音符的 Ć, Ń, Ó, Ś, Ź。其中 Ń 是波蘭語獨有。此外，唯一其他包含 Ś 和 Ź 的語言是蒙特內哥羅語。
- 帶有一小點的 Ż（波蘭語獨有）
波蘭語包含大量子音，有許多子音群。波蘭語不使用 V，而是大量使用 W，這是唯一這樣做的斯拉夫語。其他異常常見的子音還有 Z、K 和 C。

text: While rare, bilingual signs can be found in the highlighted regions.
- **Kashubian**, found in the north, is another West Slavic Language, featuring a lot of umlauts and accents.
_Wszëtczi lëdze rodzą sã wòlny ë równy w swòji czëstnoce ë swòjich prawach. Mają òni dostóne rozëm ë sëmienié ë nôlégô jima pòstãpòwac wobec drëdzich w dëchù bracënotë._
- **German** is mostly found in the Opole Voivodeship.
- **Lithuanian **can be found around Puńsk, near the Lithuanian border.
- **Belarusian** is found near the Belarusian border.
- **Lemko, **another Cyrillic language, can be found in the southeast.
text_zh: 雖然罕見，但在突顯的地區中可以找到雙語標誌。
- **卡舒比語（Kashubian）**可在北部找到，是另一種西斯拉夫語言，帶有許多變音符號與腔調。
_Wszëtczi lëdze rodzą sã wòlny ë równy w swòji czëstnoce ë swòjich prawach. Mają òni dostóne rozëm ë sëmienié ë nôlégô jima pòstãpòwac wobec drëdzich w dëchù bracënotë._
- **德語**主要分佈在奧波萊省（Opole Voivodeship）。
- **立陶宛語**可以在立陶宛邊境附近的普恩斯克（Puńsk）周邊找到。
- **白俄羅斯語**可以在白俄羅斯邊境附近找到。
- **萊姆基語（Lemko）**是另一種西里爾字母語言，可在東南部找到。

text: **Portuguese** is a Romance language that is closely related to Spanish. Unlike Spanish, Portuguese includes the letters Ç, Ã, Õ, Â, and Ê, while it does not include the letter Ñ, which is very common in Spanish.
NOTE: You can also find Ç in Catalan.
text_zh: **葡萄牙語**是一種與西班牙語密切相關的羅曼語族語言。與西班牙語不同，葡萄牙語包含字母 Ç、Ã、Õ、Â 和 Ê，但不包含在西班牙語中非常常見的字母 Ñ。
NOTE: 你也可以在加泰隆尼亞語中找到 Ç。

text: Romanian is a Romance language similar to Italian, containing the following special letters:
- Ă ă
- Ș ș
- Ț ț
These letters are also found in some other European languages:
- Â â, used in French, Portuguese and Turkish
- Î î, used in French, Turkish and Italian
Additionally, in Turkish you can find the letter Ş, which can be confused with the Romanian Ș.
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞語是一種與義大利語相似的羅曼語族語言，包含以下特殊字母：
- Ă ă
- Ș ș
- Ț ț
這些字母也見於其他某些歐洲語言中：
- Â â，用於法語、葡萄牙語和土耳其語
- Î î，用於法語、土耳其語和義大利語
此外，在土耳其語中你可以找到字母 Ş，這可能會與羅馬尼亞語的 Ș 混淆。

text: In Generation 3 coverage you will somewhat commonly find unblurred licence plates, featuring a **regional code** on the right side. The codes are generally ordered alphabetically within each [type of federal subject](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_subjects_of_Russia#Types), starting at republics and ending with autonomous okrugs. Therefore, the [Republic of Adygea](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PhX9zVnMQfBCvHQi7) will be represented by 01, and the [Amur Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AXNwmSJ1vio1pRCo7) by 28, both being the first alphabetical subjects of republics and oblasts respectively. If you encounter a [three digit code](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BiQGFQEG51Xxc7fc7), the second and third digit will form the regional code, in this case 123 becomes 23, for Krasnodar Krai. You may also find the codes written out on the back of [trucks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NVQNyKpSUXZ3i4LG6) and [vans](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6511783,66.3012014,3a,15y,5.71h,78.8t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8nSDptPKXAhrtGZE6nzskg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 在 Generation 3 街景中，你常會看到未模糊的車牌，其右側標有**區域代碼**。這些代碼通常在各個[聯邦主體類型](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_subjects_of_Russia#Types)內按字母順序排列，從共和國開始，到自治區結束。因此，[阿迪格共和國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PhX9zVnMQfBCvHQi7)會以 01 表示，而[阿穆爾州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AXNwmSJ1vio1pRCo7)則以 28 表示，兩者分別為共和國和州按字母順序排列的第一個主體。如果你遇到[三位數代碼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BiQGFQEG51Xxc7fc7)，第二和第三位數字將組成區域代碼，在此例中，123 變成克拉斯諾達爾邊疆區的 23。你也可以在[卡車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NVQNyKpSUXZ3i4LG6)和[廂型車](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6511783,66.3012014,3a,15y,5.71h,78.8t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s8nSDptPKXAhrtGZE6nzskg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的後方找到寫出來的代碼。

text: Saransk has an exclusive circular street sign design with the street name being written in up to **4 different languages**.
text_zh: 薩蘭斯克擁有獨特的圓形路標設計，路標上的街道名稱最多以 **4 種不同的語言**書寫。

text: The official and most common language seen in Senegal is French.
NOTE: The other sub-Saharan countries with street view coverage use English (Rwanda being a minor exception to this – however landscape should be sufficient to always tell the difference).
text_zh: 在塞內加爾看到官方且最常見的語言是法文。
注意：其他有街景覆蓋的撒哈拉以南國家使用的是英文（盧安達是個小例外——不過風景通常就足以分辨差異）。

text: Most Singaporean licence plates are **black, with white text**. Occasionally, you will be able to see the British style **white-and-yellow** plates and very rarely red plates.
NOTE: Neighbouring Malaysia and Indonesia also use black plates with white text. However, the letters will usually be divided into two or three sections - this is not the case for Singaporean plates.
text_zh: 大多數新加坡車牌是**黑底白字**。偶爾你會看到英式風格的**白黃相間**車牌，極少數情況下會看到紅色的車牌。
注意：鄰近的馬來西亞和印尼也使用黑底白字車牌。然而，它們的字母通常會分成兩到三個區段——新加坡車牌則非如此。

text: Directional signs are also **green**, with white letters and English writing.
NOTE: Expressways each have a **three-letter code** (e.g. TPE), making them easy to spot on signs.
text_zh: 方向標誌也是**綠色**的，帶有白色字母和英文書寫。
注意：每條快速公路都有一個**三字母代碼**（例如 TPE），使得它們在標誌上很容易被認出。

text: Warnings are often written **on the road** in large letters, such as the famous “HUMP AHEAD”.
text_zh: 警告標語經常以大號字體寫**在路面上**，例如著名的「HUMP AHEAD」（前方有隆起路面）。

text: Slovak and Czech are mutually intelligible Slavic languages with several similarities such as acute accents above vowels (á, é, í, ó, ú, ý). However, they both have some distinct letters:
- Slovak uses the letters **Ľ**, **Ô**, **Ä**, **Ŕ** and **Ĺ**;
- Czech uses the letters Ř, Ě and Ů.
NOTE: Acute accents on vowels are not found in [South Slavic languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Slavic_languages).
text_zh: 斯洛伐克語和捷克語是互通的斯拉夫語言，有幾個相似之處，例如母音上方的急性符號（á、é、í、ó、ú、ý）。然而，它們各自有一些獨特的字母：
- 捷克語使用字母 Ř、Ě 和 Ů。
注意：[南斯拉夫語言](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Slavic_languages)中沒有母音尖音符。

text: Slovak cycling signs use the letter **C** as their symbol, unique to the country. They’re visually analogous to the Czechoslovak hiking markers mentioned in step 1.1, including the [yellow post](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CG99xS8ZvRjQEERg8) on directional signs.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的自行車標誌使用字母 **C** 作為其符號，這是該國特有的。它們在視覺上類似於步驟 1.1 中提到的捷克斯洛伐克健行標記，包括方向標誌上的[黃色柱子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/CG99xS8ZvRjQEERg8)。

text: In the northeastern parts of the Prešov region, you may find bilingual town entry signs in [Rusyn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rusyn_language), a Cyrillic based language closely related to Ukrainian.
text_zh: 在普雷紹夫（Prešov）地區的東北部，你可能會找到以[盧森尼亞語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rusyn_language)書寫的雙語城鎮入口標誌，這是一種與烏克蘭語密切相關的斯拉夫語系語言。

text: Slovene is a **Slavic language** featuring the special letters Č, Š, and Ž. It is closely related to Croatian, Serbian and Montenegrin.
NOTE: On top of having the same letters as Slovene, Croatian also has the letters Ć and Đ.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞語是一種**斯拉夫語言**，具有 Č、Š 和 Ž 等特殊字母。它與克羅埃西亞語、塞爾維亞語和蒙特內哥羅語高度相關。
註：除了擁有和斯洛維尼亞語相同的字母外，克羅埃西亞語還擁有 Ć 和 Đ 字母。

text: South Africa has **11 official languages**: English, Afrikaans, and various Bantu languages. English is the [lingua franca](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lingua_franca) and therefore appears most often on signage.

**Afrikaans** is a Germanic language that is closely related to Dutch. Common Afrikaans place name suffixes are -fontein, -kraal, -kop, -dorp, -nek, and -berg or -burg. While Afrikaans is most commonly spoken in the [western half](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/16/South_Africa_2011_Afrikaans_speakers_proportion_map.svg/2337px-South_Africa_2011_Afrikaans_speakers_proportion_map.svg.png) of the country, you will find Afrikaans place names all over South Africa, meaning that it is not useful for region-guessing.
NOTE: Afrikaans is rare to non-existent in Eswatini and Lesotho. It is also abundantly rare in Botswana, but has some limited presence in the form of place names.
text_zh: 南非有 **11 種官方語言**：英語、南非語以及各種班圖語。英語是[通用語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lingua_franca)，因此最常出現在標誌上。

**南非語**是一種與荷蘭語密切相關的日耳曼語族語言。常見的南非語地名字尾有 -fontein、-kraal、-kop、-dorp、-nek 以及 -berg 或 -burg。雖然南非語最常在該國的[西部半部](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/16/South_Africa_2011_Afrikaans_speakers_proportion_map.svg/2337px-South_Africa_2011_Afrikaans_speakers_proportion_map.svg.png)被使用，但你在全南非各地都能找到南非語地名，這意味著它對地區猜測沒有幫助。
註：南非語在史瓦帝尼和賴索托非常罕見甚至不存在。它在波札那也極其罕見，但以地名的形式存在有限的能見度。

text: A map of major highways in South Africa. On road signs, the **letter ‘N’ **should appear in front of the highway number. On Google Maps, however, the letter ‘N’ will not be present. Instead, a **blue pentagon** with the number will be displayed.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 南非主要高速公路地圖。在道路標誌上，高速公路編號前方應會出現**字母「N」**。然而，在 Google 地圖上，字母「N」將不會出現，取而代之的是顯示帶有編號的**藍色五邊形**。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Metropolitan Routes** are major roads around cities. They are designated with the letter M.
These distinct and unique M route signs are commonly found in [Port Elizabeth](https://goo.gl/maps/ZfbwsNaUjonKnoAY9) (Gqeberha) and [Durban](https://goo.gl/maps/C94hkSvFEopmUoJx9), respectively.
text_zh: **都會路線 (Metropolitan Routes)**是城市周邊的主要道路，以字母 M 命名。
這些獨特的 M 路線標誌分別常見於[伊莉莎白港](https://goo.gl/maps/ZfbwsNaUjonKnoAY9)（格克貝哈）和[德班](https://goo.gl/maps/C94hkSvFEopmUoJx9)。

text: The Korean writing system ([Hangul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hangul)) is very unique and recognizable. One of its standout features is the presence of **circles** in many of its letters. This sets it apart from most other East Asian writing systems.
text_zh: 韓文字母系統（[諺文](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hangul)）非常獨特且易於辨識。其最突出的特徵之一是許多字母中都有**圓圈**。這使它與大多數其他東亞文字系統區分開來。

text: Korean buildings have very distinctive **house numbers**. They are blue and usually are shaped quite literally like a house. The full address of the building is written on them, in both Hangul and Latin script.
Some places have unique house numbers, which you can use to region-guess. More information about this can be found in the spotlight section.
text_zh: 南韓建築物有非常獨特的**門牌號碼**。它們是藍色的，通常字面上就做成房子的形狀。建築物的完整地址寫在上面，包含諺文和拉丁字母。
有些地方有獨特的門牌號碼，你可以用來進行地區猜測。關於這點的更多資訊可以在焦點（spotlight）部分找到。

text: Spain has distinct road markers with a variety of **colourful borders**. The code on top is the number of the road.

NOTE: Andorra has [similar markers](https://goo.gl/maps/FEWfZhUVrr8EUTv28) and the letter codes preceding the road number on these markers are often an important region-specific clue. You can learn more about these codes in the region guessing section.
text_zh: 西班牙有著獨特的道路里程碑，帶有各種**色彩繽紛的邊框**。頂部的代碼是道路編號。
注意：安道爾有[類似的里程碑](https://goo.gl/maps/FEWfZhUVrr8EUTv28)，這些里程碑上道路編號前方的字母代碼通常是重要的地區特定線索。你可以在地區猜測部分了解更多關於這些代碼的資訊。

text: **Spanish** is the main language in most of the country. It is a Romance language that is closely related to Portuguese.
Spanish and Portuguese can look very similar. Some key differences between the two:
- Ñ is unique to Spanish.
- Ç and lh are unique to Portuguese (Ç is also present in Catalan).
- Portuguese uses the -ao word ending, and -nh- instead of ñ.
- Spanish uses de and del, while these are often contracted to da, do, das and dos in Portuguese.
NOTE: Spain also has several regional languages, some of which are more common than Spanish in their respective regions. These languages are discussed in more detail in the region-guessing section.
text_zh: **西班牙語**是該國大部分地區的主要語言。它是一種與葡萄牙語密切相關的羅曼語族語言。
西班牙語和葡萄牙語看起來非常相似。兩者的一些關鍵區別如下：
- Ñ 是西班牙語獨有的。
- Ç 和 lh 是葡萄牙語獨有的（Ç 在加泰隆尼亞語中也會出現）。
- 葡萄牙語使用 -ao 的字尾，並用 -nh- 代替 ñ。
- 西班牙語使用 de 和 del，而在葡萄牙語中這些通常會縮寫為 da、do、das 和 dos。
注意：西班牙也有幾種區域語言，其中某些語言在其各自的地區比西班牙語更常見。這些語言將在區域猜測章節中更詳細地討論。

text: Spain has several regional languages. The ones that are most useful to GeoGuessr are **Catalan**, **Basque** and **Galician**.
Some other regions, such as Asturias, also have their own regional languages. But there, non-Spanish signage is much more rare.
text_zh: 西班牙有幾種區域語言。對 GeoGuessr 最有幫助的是**加泰隆尼亞語**、**巴斯克語**和**加利西亞語**。
其他一些地區（例如阿斯圖里亞斯）也有自己的區域語言。但在那裡，非西班牙語的招牌要罕見得多。

text: **Catalan** is a Romance language that is closely related to both Spanish and French.

It is spoken in Catalonia, the Valencian Community, and the Balearic Islands. In Catalonia and the Balearic Islands, it is (much) more common than Spanish on signage. The Valencian Community is more bilingual.
If you are unfamiliar with Romance languages, it can be hard to distinguish between Catalan and Spanish.
- The Catalan word for “and” is **i**, compared to Spanish y.
- The grave accent (**à, è, ò**), is exclusive to Catalan within Spain and very common to see in words, especially on à.
- The c with cedilla (**ç**) is also exclusive to Catalan within Spain.
text_zh: **Catalan（加泰隆尼亞語）**是一種羅曼語族語言，與西班牙語和法語都有很深的淵源。
它通行於加泰隆尼亞、瓦倫西亞自治區和巴利阿里群島。在加泰隆尼亞和巴利阿里群島，招牌上的加泰隆尼亞語比西班牙語（得多）。瓦倫西亞自治區則更具雙語特性。
如果你對羅曼語族不熟悉，就很難區分加泰隆尼亞語和西班牙語。
- 加泰隆尼亞語的「and（和）」是 **i**，而西班牙語則是 y。
- 重音符號（**à, è, ò**）在西班牙境內是加泰隆尼亞語獨有的，在單字中非常常見，尤其是 à。
- 帶 cedilla 的 c（**ç**）在西班牙境內也僅見於加泰隆尼亞語。

text: **Basque** is a language isolate that is spoken in the Basque Country and northern Navarre. In these regions, you will find a mix of Spanish and Basque signs (often bilingual).
Basque is not related to any other language, so it has a unique look. Z and K are common letters.
NOTE: Basque is also used in the border area of southwest France.
text_zh: **Basque（巴斯克語）**是一門語言孤立（語言 isolate），通行於巴斯克自治區和納瓦拉北部。在這些地區，你會看到西班牙語和巴斯克語混用的招牌（通常是雙語的）。
巴斯克語與任何其他語言都沒有親緣關係，因此它有著獨特的外觀。Z 和 K 是常見的字母。
注意：巴斯克語也用於法國西南部的邊境地區。

text: **Galician** is a Romance language that is closely related to Portuguese. It is (unsurprisingly) spoken in Galicia. Compared to Catalan, it is less dominant, meaning you will still find a lot of Spanish-only signs in this region.
Galician can look very similar to Portuguese. Some ways to tell them apart is the use of **ñ** and the lack of **ç** in Galician.
text_zh: **Galician（加利西亞語）**是一種羅曼語族語言，與葡萄牙語有很深的淵源。它（不出意料地）通行於加利西亞。與加泰隆尼亞語相比，它的優勢較低，這意味著你在該地區仍然會找到大量純西班牙語的招牌。
加利西亞語看起來與葡萄牙語非常相似。區分它們的一些方法是加利西亞語中使用了 **ñ** 且缺乏 **ç**。

text: In Sri Lanka, you will see two scripts: **Sinhala** and **Tamil**. You will also sometimes see English, written in Latin script.
Sinhala is most common, and can be found throughout the entire country. It has a very curvy, ‘rounded’ look.
Tamil is more regionally limited. It has straighter lines. For an exact distribution, see the region-guessing section.
NOTE: Sinhala is unique to Sri Lanka. However, Tamil can also be found in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
text_zh: 在斯里蘭卡，你會看到兩種文字：**僧伽羅文（Sinhala）** 和 **泰米爾文（Tamil）**。你 parfois 也會看到用拉丁字母書寫的英文。
僧伽羅文最為常見，遍布全國各地。它具有非常流暢、「圓潤」的外觀。
泰米爾文的區域限制較多。它的線條更直。如需確切分布，請參閱區域猜測章節。
注意：僧伽羅文是斯里蘭卡特有的。然而，泰米爾文也可以在印度泰米爾納德邦找到。

text: The presence of the **Tamil script** is strongly correlated with the distribution of Hinduism (though not all Tamils are Hindu and vice versa).
There are two groups that use the Tamil script:
- Native Sri Lankan Tamils, who predominantly live in the north and the east.
- Indian Tamils, who mostly live in and around the central Nuwara Eliya district.

Note that it is not uncommon to find bilingual Sinhala and Tamil signs far outside the area where Tamil is the predominant language. However, Tamil-only signage can be a strong indicator for one of the Tamil-majority areas.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: **泰米爾文** 的存在與印度教的分布有強烈的相關性（儘管並非所有泰米爾人都是印度教徒，反之亦然）。
有兩個群體使用泰米爾文：
- 本地斯里蘭卡泰米爾人，主要居住在北部和東部。
- 印度泰米爾人，主要居住在中部努沃勒埃利耶地區及其周圍。
請注意，在泰米爾語為主要語言的區域之外，發現雙語的僧伽羅文和泰米爾文標誌並不罕見。然而，純泰米爾文標誌可能是泰米爾人多數地區的強烈指標。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Swedish** is a North Germanic language that is closely related to Danish and Norwegian. The Swedish alphabet contains the special letters **Å**, **Ä** and **Ö**.
NOTE: The special letters found in Swedish can also be found in some of the other Northern Germanic languages:
- Danish uses Å, but not** **Ä or Ö.
- Norwegian uses Å, but not** **Ä or Ö.
- Icelandic uses Ö, but not Å or Ä.
Finnish uses Ä and Ö. Å is also used, but is treated as Swedish. Finnish words are typically longer and often use double vowels, which are very rare in Swedish.
text_zh: **瑞典語**是一種北日耳曼語支的語言，與丹麥語和挪威語密切相關。瑞典語字母包含特殊字母 **Å**、**Ä** 和 **Ö**。
注意：瑞典語中的特殊字母也可以在其他一些北日 Germanic 語言中找到：
- 丹麥語使用 Å，但沒有** **Ä 或 Ö。
- 挪威語使用 Å，但沒有** **Ä 或 Ö。
- 冰島語使用 Ö，但沒有 Å 或 Ä。
芬蘭語使用 Ä 和 Ö。Å 也會使用，但被視為瑞典語字母。芬蘭語單字通常較長，且常使用雙母音，這在瑞典語中非常罕見。

text: On smaller roads, it is common to see these blue signs with a **large white** **M**.

NOTE: Similar signs can be found in [Norway](https://www.google.com/maps/@62.658516,9.2730549,3a,15y,100.11h,87.29t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPzXte8Lu53s2vN1K2XWVmA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656), however the font is distinctly different. The middle point of the M extends to the bottom of the letter. There are no similar signs in Finland.
text_zh: 在較小的道路上，經常可以看到這些帶有**大型白色** **M** 的藍色標誌。
注意：類似的標誌可以在[挪威](https://www.google.com/maps/@62.658516,9.2730549,3a,15y,100.11h,87.29t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sPzXte8Lu53s2vN1K2XWVmA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)找到，然而字體明顯不同。M 的中間點延伸到字母底部。芬蘭沒有類似的標誌。

text: **Meänkieli** is a language closely related to Finnish, which is found close to the Finnish border. One of the most common occurrences on signage is for river names, which will end in “**väylä**”. It is also possible to find [trilingual signs](https://goo.gl/maps/H72p2C2LGP9XyGix7) with both Meänkieli and Sámi.
NOTE: As a general principle, if you encounter [Finnish sounding place names](https://goo.gl/maps/WN3DjPtD6WosR8dv6), you are also likely to be fairly close to the Finnish border.
text_zh: **梅因基利語（Meänkieli）**是一種與芬蘭語密切相關的語言，分佈在芬蘭邊境附近。標誌中最常見的情況之一是河流名稱，其結尾會是「**väylä**」。也有可能找到同時有梅因基利語和薩米語的[三語標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/H72p2C2LGP9XyGix7)。
注意：一般原則是，如果你遇到[聽起來像芬蘭語的地名](https://goo.gl/maps/WN3DjPtD6WosR8dv6)，你通常也相當靠近芬蘭邊境。

text: [Elfdalian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elfdalian) is a language that is exclusively found in and around Älvdalen. It is most commonly seen on street signs, with street names typically ending in **“-ween”** or [“-weg”](https://goo.gl/maps/Xo1Zu7hKzGYhzHom9).
text_zh: [艾爾夫達倫語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elfdalian)是一種僅在艾爾夫達倫（Älvdalen）及周邊地區使用的語言。它最常出現在路標上，街名通常以 **“-ween”** 或 [“-weg”](https://goo.gl/maps/Xo1Zu7hKzGYhzHom9) 結尾。

text: Switzerland has **four official languages**: German, French, Italian and [Romansh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romansh_language), which are spoken in the regions shown. Note that some areas, mostly near the region borders, are bilingual.
NOTE: Unlike Germany and Austria, Swiss German does not use the letter **ß**.
text_zh: 瑞士有**四種官方語言**：德語、法語、義大利語及[羅曼什語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Romansh_language)，其分佈區域如圖所示。請注意，有些地區（大多靠近語言區邊界）是雙語區。
註：與德國和奧地利不同，瑞士德語不使用 **ß** 這個字母。

text: The text on the **speed limit signs** varies depending on the official languages in the region.
text_zh: **速限標誌**上的文字會根據該地區的官方語言而有所不同。

text: **Cantons** are the first-level administrative division of Switzerland. It is very common to find the two-letter abbreviation for the canton that you are in, as seen on some town entry signs. As such, remembering these can be a great asset when region-guessing Switzerland.
NOTE: If you happen to come across an [unblurred licence plate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA), the first two letters will correspond to the canton that it is registered in.
text_zh: **州（Cantons）**是瑞士的第一級行政區劃。你經常可以在某些城鎮入口標誌上找到你所在州的兩位字母縮寫。因此，記住這些縮寫在進行瑞士區域猜測（region-guessing）時會是一大優勢。
註：如果你剛好遇到一個[未模糊的車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yi7rVDEFGXqwZaWSA)，前兩個字母將對應到該車輛註冊的州。

text: **Portuguese** is the main language used on São Tomé and Príncipe.
text_zh: **葡萄牙語**是聖多美和普林西比主要使用的語言。

text: Taiwan uses **Traditional Chinese**. It is one of the most complex scripts visible on street view, with intricate characters that consist of many strokes.
NOTE: Hong Kong also uses traditional Chinese characters on signage.

!!Japanese uses some Chinese characters (kanji), meaning the script can look somewhat similar. However, Japanese will also have a considerable amount of more simplified looking characters (katakana and hiragana).
text_zh: 台灣使用**繁體中文**，是街景中看得到的文字系統裡最複雜的之一，字形結構繁複、筆畫數多。
註：香港的招牌同樣使用繁體字。
!!日文也會使用漢字，所以乍看之下有些相似。但日文同時會出現大量筆畫簡單得多的字符（片假名與平假名）。

text: **Thai script** is compact and in many fonts has tiny circles within most letters.

NOTE: The Cambodian (Khmer) script often has longer lines and more accents underneath the lettering, as opposed to the Thai script. The Lao script looks similar to the Thai script. Make sure to check the driving side before guessing.
text_zh: **泰文**結構緊湊，在許多字體中，多數字母內部都有小圓圈。
註：與泰文相比，柬埔寨文（高棉文）通常有更長的線條，且字母下方有更多裝飾符號。寮文看起來與泰文相似。猜測前請務必檢查行駛車道。

text: Directional signs on smaller roads are **white**, and are composed of two signs: one with an arrow at the bottom, and one with the information at the top. These can have place names. When they do not, you will see them as just the road number with a [Garuda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emblem_of_Thailand). Moreover, highway signs are **green**, and frequently feature the place names in Latin script below the Thai name.
text_zh: 小路上的指路標誌是**白色**的，由兩個標誌組成：一個底部帶有箭頭，另一個頂部包含資訊。這些標誌可能帶有地名。當沒有地名時，你只會看到道路編號搭配一個[迦樓羅](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Emblem_of_Thailand)標誌。此外，高速公路標誌是**綠色**的，且通常在泰文名稱下方以拉丁字母標示地名。

text: Stop signs in Thailand feature the **Thai script**, instead of Latin.
NOTE: Stop signs in Laos feature the Lao script, similar to Thai, but they have just 2 characters instead of 3.
text_zh: 泰國的停止標誌使用**泰文**，而非拉丁字母。
註：寮國的停止標誌使用寮文，外觀類似泰文，但只有 2 個字元而非 3 個。

text: Waystones and road signs on provincial roads will often provide a **two-letter abbreviation** of the province in Thai script. They will not appear on waystones or road signs for national roads.
You can use [this](https://super-duper.fr/country/thailand_provinces_en.php) site to view and practice all province abbreviations.
text_zh: 省道上的里程碑和道路標誌通常會以泰文字體提供該省份的**兩位字母縮寫**。國道的里程碑或道路標誌上不會出現這些縮寫。
你可以使用[這個](https://super-duper.fr/country/thailand_provinces_en.php)網站來檢視並練習所有省份縮寫。

text: These **black boxes** will often provide a **three-letter abbreviation** of the province. Two formats are used:
- Starting with the abbreviation followed by 4 numbers
- Starting with TCC-L2, or rarely TCC-L1, followed by the abbreviation
Shown in the picture is the abbreviation “NTB” for Nonthaburi. The abbreviations may vary slightly in each province depending on the format.
NOTE: Other boxes may feature different formats that correspond to the subdistrict of the province.
text_zh: 這些**黑色箱子**通常會提供該省份的**三位字母縮寫**。使用兩種格式：
- 以縮寫開頭，後面接 4 個數字
- 以 TCC-L2 開頭（極少數為 TCC-L1），後面接縮寫
圖片中顯示的是暖武里府（Nonthaburi）的縮寫「NTB」。各省份的縮寫可能會根據格式略有不同。
注意：其他箱子可能會採用對應到省內分區的不同格式。

text: The majority of **Muslims** in Thailand live in the very south of the country. In these areas, you will often see Islamic religious attire, [Jawi script](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jawi_script), based on the Arabic script, on [signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oy83kvBm8XWcc3ZEA) and mosques.
text_zh: 泰國的大多數**穆斯林**都住在極南部的地區。在這些地方，你經常會看到伊斯蘭教宗教服飾，以及基於阿拉伯字母的[爪夷文](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jawi_script)出現在[招牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oy83kvBm8XWcc3ZEA)和清真寺上。

text: In Tunisia, both **French and Arabic** are common. The Arabic script can be identified by its lines and dots. You can often see [bilingual signs](https://goo.gl/maps/gS1SqVNEC2RM3KPq8).
NOTE: The UAE and (more rarely) Jordan use English and Arabic.
text_zh: 在突尼西亞，**法語和阿拉伯語**都很常見。阿拉伯文書寫系統可以透過其線條和點來辨識。你常會看到[雙語標示](https://goo.gl/maps/gS1SqVNEC2RM3KPq8)。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國和（較少見的）約旦也會使用英語和阿拉伯語。

text: Most direction signs have a **white** background with towns listed in Arabic and Latin script. The font of the Latin script is usually quite distinctive.
NOTE: Many direction signs include the capital Tunis, but this does not necessarily mean you are anywhere near that city.
text_zh: 大多數的方向指示牌都有**白色**背景，並以阿拉伯文和拉丁字母列出城鎮名稱。拉丁字母的字體通常相當具有特色。
注意：許多方向指示牌會包含首都突尼斯，但這並不一定代表你就在該城市附近。

text: Tunisia has a fairly unique **stop sign** with Arabic and Latin script.
NOTE: Similar stop signs can be found in Jordan and the UAE. However, Israel and Palestine use a different unique stop sign with a [hand](https://goo.gl/maps/rDWg2Ff166WhVLax9) instead of text.
text_zh: 突尼西亞有一個相當獨特的**停止標誌**，上面有阿拉伯文和拉丁字母。
注意：類似的停止標誌可以在約旦和阿拉伯聯合大公國找到。然而，以色列和巴勒斯坦使用的是另一個獨特的停止標誌，上面有[手掌](https://goo.gl/maps/rDWg2Ff166WhVLax9)而不是文字。

text: The Turkish language has a fairly unique look. It uses the following special characters:
- Ç ç and Ş ş with a [cedilla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cedilla) (“hook” below the letter).
- Ö ö and Ü ü with an [umlaut](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umlaut_(diacritic)) (two dots).
- Ğ ğ with a [breve](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breve).
- Dotless I ı. This letter in particular is noteworthy, as it is essentially unique to Turkish. In case you are confused: this is similar to the letter i, but without a dot when written in lowercase.
- Capital İ with a dot.
text_zh: 土耳其語的外觀相當獨特。它使用下列特殊字元：
-帶有[Cedilla](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cedilla)（字母下方的「勾」）的 Ç ç 和 Ş ş。
- Ö ö 和 Ü ü，帶有[分音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Umlaut_(diacritic))（兩個點）。
- Ğ ğ，帶有[短音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Breve)。
- 無點 ı。這個字母特別值得注意，因為它基本上是土耳其語特有的。如果你感到困惑：這類似於字母 i，但在寫成小寫時沒有上面的點。
- 大寫帶點的 İ。

text: Direction signs use a very distinct font that can often be recognised by the noticeably **wide letter spaces**.
text_zh: 方向指示牌使用非常獨特的字體，通常可以透過明顯**寬敞的字元間距**來辨識。

text: The third type of roads are provincial roads. While these generally aren’t labelled on the map, they can still be used to regionguess since the kilometre markers feature the [**provincial code**](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/turkey?authuser=0) as the first two digits on the sign. These codes generally increase alphabetically from 01 to 76 with some newer regions being unordered. Shown in the image is a road from the Afyon Province (03).
text_zh: 第三種道路是省道。雖然這些道路通常不會在地圖上標示，但它們仍然可以用來進行地區猜測，因為公里標示將[**省份代碼**](https://sites.google.com/site/roadnumberingsystems/home/countries/turkey?authuser=0)作為標誌上的前兩位數字。這些代碼通常按字母順序從 01 遞增到 76，其中一些較新的地區則沒有順序。圖片中顯示的是來自阿菲永省（03）的一條道路。

text: The Ukrainian language uses the **Cyrillic** script.
These letters are unique to Ukrainian, compared to Russian:
- Є є (not to be confused with Э э in Russian and Belarusian.)
- Ґ ґ
- І і
- Ї ї
NOTE: Other European languages that use Cyrillic include Russian, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Serbian, and Macedonian.
text_zh: 烏克蘭語使用**西里爾**字母。
與俄羅斯相比，這些字母是烏克蘭獨有的：
- Є є（不要與俄羅斯語和白俄羅斯語中的 Э э 混淆。）
- Ґ ґ
- І і
- Ї ї
備註：其他使用西里爾字母的歐洲語言包括俄羅斯語、白俄羅斯語、保加利亞語、塞爾維亞語和馬其頓語。

text: The Ukrainian word for city is **місто** (misto), abbreviated **м.** (m.). It can be used both to differentiate it from other Cyrillic languages and to quickly find the city name in addresses.
text_zh: 烏克蘭語的「城市」是 **місто** (misto)，縮寫為 **м.** (m.)。這既可用於將其與其他西里爾語系區分開來，也可用於在地址中快速找到城市名稱。

text: The first two letters on Ukrainian licence plates determine in which oblast the vehicle is registered in, making unblurred licence plates very useful for regionguessing. Unlike most regional plates in Europe, they’re not intuitive, so learning the codes beforehand is essential for utilising them.

NOTE: The map shown only applies to the most recent and common plates, with a [blue and yellow strip](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JBdhZAFtT8ad6JXX8). The [older plates](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xT84P2MZ6J22UtxB8) use a regional [number code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_registration_plates_of_Ukraine#Regional_codes), similar to Russia.
text_zh: 烏克蘭車牌上的前兩個字母決定了車輛是在哪個州註冊的，這使得未模糊的車牌對於區域猜測非常有用。與歐洲大多數區域車牌不同，它們並不直觀，因此事先學習代碼對於利用它們至關重要。

備註：顯示的地圖僅適用於最新且最常見的車牌，帶有[藍黃相間的條紋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JBdhZAFtT8ad6JXX8)。[較舊的車牌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xT84P2MZ6J22UtxB8)使用類似俄羅斯的區域[數字代碼](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_registration_plates_of_Ukraine#Regional_codes)。

text: The **Russian language** can be found in Ukraine, particularly in the east and south. While there are several differences between Russian and Ukrainian, these are some of the most noteworthy:
- The letters Ы ы, Э э are only found in Russian.
- The Russian word for street is улица, abbreviated ул.
- The Russian word for city is город, abbreviated г.
text_zh: 烏克蘭可以見到**俄羅斯語**，特別是在東部和南部。雖然俄羅斯語和烏克蘭語之間存在幾個差異，但以下是一些最值得注意的：
- 字母 Ы ы、Э э 僅見於俄羅斯語。
- 俄羅斯語的「街道」是 улица，縮寫為 ул。
- 俄羅斯語的「城市」是 город，縮寫為 г。

text: The area near the border with Hungary is majority Hungarian. As a result, you will see a lot of signs with **Hungarian language** on it – bilingual or even monolingual.
text_zh: 靠近匈牙利邊境的地區以匈牙利人居多。因此，你會看到很多帶有**匈牙利語**的標誌——雙語甚至單語。

text: The official language in the UAE is Arabic. Its script can be identified by its **lines and dots**.
NOTE: Due to high tourism, signs in the UAE often have English writing alongside Arabic. While this is also common in Qatar and Oman, it is not common in Jordan.
text_zh: 阿拉伯聯合大公國（UAE）的官方語言是阿拉伯語。其文字可以透過**線條與點**來辨識。
注意：由於觀光業發達，阿拉伯聯合大公國的標誌通常除了阿拉伯文外，還會附帶英文。雖然這在卡達和阿曼也很常見，但在約旦則不常見。

text: Direction signs in the United Kingdom can be **blue, green, or white.** Look for the letters **A** or **M**, as these are the major roads in the country. Smaller roads start with **B**.
NOTE: Irish direction signs are typically bilingual, with Irish names in italics, making them easy to distinguish from the UK ones.
text_zh: 英國的指示標誌可以是**藍色、綠色或白色。**尋找字母 **A** 或 **M**，因為這些是該國的主要道路。較小的道路以 **B** 開頭。
注意：愛爾蘭的指示標誌通常是雙語的，愛爾蘭文名稱會使用斜體，使其易於與英國的標誌區分。

text: **Welsh** is a Celtic language that is spoken throughout Wales. Road signs in Wales are usually bilingual English and Welsh. Towns often have Welsh names too.
Welsh uses the letters **D**, **W**, and **Y** much more commonly than English. The double **LL** is also very distinct.
NOTE: Scottish Gaelic and Irish are both also Celtic languages. They can look somewhat similar to Welsh.
text_zh: **威爾斯語**是一種凱爾特語，在整個威爾斯都有人使用。威爾斯的路標通常是英語和威爾斯語的雙語標誌。城鎮通常也有威爾斯語名稱。
威爾斯語使用字母 **D**、**W** 和 **Y** 的頻率比英語高得多。雙寫 **LL** 也非常獨特。
注意：蘇格蘭蓋爾語和愛爾蘭語也都是凱爾特語。它們看起來可能與威爾斯語有些相似。

text: In Wales, markings on the road are in both English and Welsh. One of the best examples of this is ‘**Araf**’, which means ‘Slow’. This marking is only found in Wales.

NOTE: Araf is not the only Welsh language marking you can find, it is just the most common. Whenever you see an [obviously non-English](https://goo.gl/maps/zqv7eS2fjFDEjS2f8) marking next to an English one, consider guessing in Wales.
text_zh: 在威爾斯，道路標線同時使用英文和威爾斯文。其中最好的例子之一是「**Araf**」，意思是「慢行」。這種標線僅在威爾斯找到。
注意：Araf 並不是你能找到的唯一的威爾斯語標記，它只是最常見的。每當你在英語標記旁邊看到[明顯非英語](https://goo.gl/maps/zqv7eS2fjFDEjS2f8)的標記時，請考慮猜威爾斯。

text: **Scottish Gaelic** is a Celtic language that is closely related to Irish. They have a very similar look and use accent marks commonly. Common and recognizable letter clusters include bh, dh, fh, mh, ai, ea, eo, and ui.
Scottish Gaelic on road signs is found most commonly in the Scottish Highlands, and is almost always found north of Glasgow.
NOTE: Scottish Gaelic on road signs will often be in green or yellow text. This will not happen with Welsh or Irish on road signs.
text_zh: **蘇格蘭蓋爾語**是一種與愛爾蘭語密切相關的凱爾特語。它們的外觀非常相似，並且常用變音符號。常見且可辨識的字母組合包括 bh、dh、fh、mh、ai、ea、eo 和 ui。
路標上的蘇格蘭蓋爾語最常在蘇格蘭高地找到，且幾乎總是位於格拉斯哥以北。
注意：路標上的蘇格蘭蓋爾語通常會是綠色或黃色的文字。這在威爾斯語或愛爾蘭語的路標上是不會發生的。

text: Most street signs in the Wakefield council are black with a white outline and letters. They use the Monotype Rockwell Nova font.
text_zh: 韋克菲爾德（Wakefield）市議會轄區內的大多數路標都是黑色底，帶有白色的外框和文字。它們使用 Monotype Rockwell Nova 字型。

text: The Vietnamese language uses a modified version of the Latin script, but with a far larger number of **diacritics** than any other script found on Street View. Words are generally somewhat short, typically consisting of a **single syllable**.
text_zh: 越南語使用拉丁字母的修改版本，但帶有比街景上發現的任何其他文字都要多得多的**附加符號**。單字通常有點短，通常由**單音節**組成。

text: Near the beach resorts just east of Phan Thiết city, most signs will have **Cyrillic text** alongside Vietnamese, catering to Russian tourists.
text_zh: 在潘切市東部海灘度假村附近，大多數標誌除了越南文之外還會有**斯拉夫字母文字**，以迎合俄羅斯遊客。
